April 20, 1939. Political news - 2
General Su Ping-wen, well known volunteer commander in Heilungkiang,
is reported to have commissioned by the Central Government to direct
guerilla fighting in the Northeastern Provinces. -- Wen Hui Pao, April 20.
* * *
FIGHTING BREAKS OUT AT PINGHU AREA
The Pinghu area in northern Chekiang was the scene of fierce fighting
between Chinese guerillas and Japanese forces last week, according to a
report just received here.
Driving down from Kashing and Fengching, approximately 2,000 Japanese
troops made a thrust on the Chinese in the vicinity of Pinghu on April 13.
The Chinese are said to have put up stiff resistance.
Following two days and half of sanguinary fighting, the Japanese were
finally compelled to retreat, leaving behind, more than 500 died. -- Sin
Wan Pao, April 20.
* * *
CHINESE CLOSING IN ON WUNING
CHANGSHA, April 19 - After occupying strategic points on the north
and west of the city, Chinese forces are advancing on Wuning on the north
bank of the Siao River, from three sides.
The Chinese are reported to have commenced their general attack on the
city today. -- Wen Hui Pao, April 20.
* * *
BRITISH ENVOY ARRIVES IN CHUNGKING
CHUNGKING, April 19 - Sir Archibald Clark-Kerr, British Ambassador to
China, arrived here from Kunming by air at 4:35 o'clock this afternoon.
Sir Archibald was greeted at the airdrome by a host of official re-
presentatives, including Mr. Hollington K. Tong, representing Generalissimo
Chiang Kai-shek, General Chang Chun and Mr. Tuan Mu-lan.
After the exchange of greetings, the British envoy was presented a copy
of the Hankow Herald in which the Generalissimo's exclusive interview with
the Reuter was printed.
It is learned here that Sir Archibald's visit to Chungking is only a
routine one and not connected with any special mission.
It is considered as a coincidence that Generalissimo's interview denounc-
ing the policy of surrender was granted to the press less than 24 hours

* * *
平湖地区爆发战斗
据刚在此收到的一份报告，上周浙江北部的平湖地区是中国游击队与日军之间激烈战斗的发生地。
4月13日，约2000名日军从嘉兴和枫泾南下，对平湖附近的中国军队发起突击。
据悉，中国军队进行了顽强抵抗。
经过两天半的血战，日军最终被迫撤退，留下500多具尸体。——《新晚报》，4月20日。
* * *
中国军队逼近武宁
长沙，4月19日——在占领该市北部和西部的战略要点后，中国军队正从三面向修水北岸的武宁推进。
据报道，中国军队已于今日开始对该市发动总攻。——《文汇报》，4月20日。
* * *
英国公使抵达重庆
重庆，4月19日——英国驻华大使阿奇博尔德·克拉克-克尔爵士（Sir Archibald Clark-Kerr）于今天下午4时35分乘飞机从昆明抵达此地。
克拉克-克尔爵士在机场受到众多官方代表的欢迎，其中包括代表蒋介石委员长的童冠贤先生、张群将军和端木兰先生。
互致问候后，英国公使获赠一份《汉口先驱报》，其中刊登了委员长接受路透社的独家访谈。
在此获悉，克拉克-克尔爵士访问重庆仅为例行访问，与任何特殊使命无关。
人们认为，委员长谴责投降政策的访谈在

before the arrival of the British Ambassador. The concensus of opinion
here is that Sir Archibald will have a chance to understand fully the
firm determination of the Chinese people to fight to a finish. -- Shun
Pao, April 20.
* * *
LEAGUE HAS OFFICE AT KUNMING
KUNMING, April 19 - The China Office of the League of Nations has
established a temporary office here. Mr. Liang Chen-sheng head of the
General Affairs Department of the League, is in charge of the
office. -- Shun Pao, April 20.
* * *
TIENTSIN MOVIE HOUSE BOMBED
HONGKONG, April 19 - Several persons were injured, when a bomb was
thrown into the Cathay Theater in the French Concession, Tientsin, at
8 o'clock last evening, according to a message from the northern port city.
The bomb thrower is still at large. It is believed here that this
plot was organized by the Japanese. -- Sin Wan Pao, April 20.
* * *
WANG CHING-WEI TRYING TO ORGANIZE PUPPET REGIME IN SHANGHAI
CHUNGKING, April 19 - Wang Ching-wei, the ousted Kuomintang leader,
is reported to have arrived in Shanghai, according to well informed
circles here.
Mr. Wang is reported to have received $10,000,000 from the Japanese
for the organization of a puppet "Central Government". -- Morning Leader,
April 20.
* * *
GUERILLA WARFARE AGAIN BREAKS OUT OUTSIDE PEIPING
HONGKONG, April 19 - A severe clash is reported to have occurred
between Japanese troops and Chinese guerillas at Mentoukou, west of Peiping,
on the morning of April 17.
By tactful maneuvers, the Chinese are said to have surrounded the
Japanese from three sides and inflicted heavy casualties on the invaders.
Simultaneously, puppet troops at the Mengtoukou sector staged a mutiny
against the Japanese and joined the Chinese forces. --Wen Hui Pao, April 20.

英国大使抵达前不到24小时见诸报端纯属巧合。此间普遍意见认为，克拉克-克尔爵士将有机会充分了解中国人民战斗到底的坚定决心。——《申报》，4月20日。
* * *
国联在昆明设立办事处
昆明，4月19日——国际联盟中国办事处已在此设立临时办公室。国联总务处处长梁辰生先生负责该办事处工作。——《申报》，4月20日。
* * *
天津电影院遭炸弹袭击
香港，4月19日——据来自北方港口城市的消息，昨晚8时，一枚炸弹被投进天津法租界的大光明戏院（Cathay Theater），造成数人受伤。
投弹者仍在逃。此间认为这一阴谋系日本人策划。——《新晚报》，4月20日。
* * *
汪精卫试图在上海组织傀儡政权
重庆，4月19日——据此间消息灵通人士称，被罢黜的国民党领导人汪精卫据报道已抵达上海。
据报道，汪先生已从日本人处获得1000万美元，用于组织一个傀儡“中央政府”。——《晨导报》，4月20日。
* * *
北平郊外再次爆发游击战
香港，4月19日——据报道，4月17日上午，日军与中国游击队在北平西面的门头沟发生激烈冲突。
据悉，中国军队通过巧妙的战术，从三面包围了日军，并给予入侵者沉重打击。
与此同时，门头沟地区的伪军发动哗变，反对日本人并加入中国军队。——《文汇报》，4月20日。

page_data.en:
April, 30, 1939.
Political news -A
RELIEF WORK OF CHINESE RED CROSS DURING HOSTILITIES
(This is the last of a series of ten articles on health work
in China during the present crisis. The articles are based
on information obtained from the National Health Administra-
tion of which Dr. F. C. Yen is the Director-General.)
A total of 1,667 doctors, nurses and dressers, including foreign volun-
teers are attending to the Chinese wounded soldiers or civilians, under
the auspices of the Medical Corps of the National Red Cross Society of China
Co-operating with the Chinese Army Medical Service, the Corps in
the past year inoculated 488,090 persons, treated 97,583 civilians and
53,914 soldiers and operated on 24,533 persons in addition to giving
first-aid to tens of thousands of people.
The remarkable growth of the Chinese Red Cross Society, which was
practically reborn a year ago, is one of China's outstanding examples of
the successful adaptation of a peacetime organization to the needs of a major
war. The Society was almost reduced to a skeleton service when Chinese
troops withdrew from the Shanghai-Nanking areas in the winter of 1937.
The Society had to abandon practically all of its hospitals in the two
cities and most of its medical equipment and possessions. It even had
considerable difficulty in extricating its own personnel.
Confronted with more pressing demands for medical care following
the extension of hostilities to other parts of China, responsible
officers of the Society, instead of being discouraged, redoubled their
efforts and revised their entire programs of medical relief. To keep
pace with the changing strategy from positional warfare to a war of
manoeuvre, the Society decided to abandon the practice of establishing
large hospitals and created in their stead mobile medical units.
The response to the call of humanity and duty has been "magnificent",
to quote a responsible officer. From all corners of the world have come
contributions of medical supplies, ambulances, and money. Doctors, nurses,
dressers, mechanics and technicians have flocked to the interior to serve
under the Red Cross banner
In the early weeks of the Shanghai fighting, surgical units were
formed in Canton and Hong Kong and rushed to the war area to supplement
the existing hospital staffs. Dr. Todd headed one group of experienced
surgeons. Mr. A. Morris, Director of Ambulance, Hong Kong St. John
Ambulance Brigade, organized a nursing unit which proceeded to Nanking.
Individuals like the late Dr. S. C. H. volunteered their services.
From overseas came groups of foreign sympathizers and patriotic
Chinese who left comfort and security behind to serve their suffering
brethren. Canada, the United States, England, Germany India, Australia
and New Zealand sent their quota of volunteers. Men like Drs: McClure,
Gray, Tremewan, Hankwy, Podgurski and Trautmann came to China to give
their services. Chinese graduates living in Europe and America returned
home on their own initiative. Professors, instructors and alumni of the
Peiping Union Medical College flocked to the banner of their colleague
Dr. Robert K. S. Lim, who is now commanding officer of the Red Cross
Medical Corps. Students and qualified nurses from every corner of the
land are on the roll.
page_data.zh:
1939年4月30日。
政治新闻 - A
战时中国红十字会的救济工作
（这是关于当前危机期间中国卫生工作的十篇文章系列的最后一篇。这些文章基于从全国卫生署获取的信息，该署署长为颜福庆博士。）
在中国红十字会医疗队的主持下，共有1667名医生、护士和敷料员（包括外国志愿者）正在照料中国伤兵或平民。
与中国陆军军医处合作，该队在去年为488,090人接种了疫苗，救治了97,583名平民和53,914名士兵，并对24,533人进行了手术，此外还为数万人提供了急救。
中国红十字会几乎在一年前重生，其显著增长是中国成功将和平时期的组织适应重大战争需求的杰出范例之一。当中国军队于1937年冬季从上海-南京地区撤退时，该会几乎缩减至仅剩骨架服务。
该会不得不放弃这两座城市几乎所有的医院以及大部分医疗设备和财产。甚至其自身人员的撤离也面临相当大的困难。
面对战火蔓延至中国其他地区后更为迫切的医疗护理需求，该会的负责官员并未气馁，反而加倍努力，并修订了其整个医疗救济计划。为了跟上从阵地战到运动战的战略变化，该会决定放弃建立大型医院的做法，转而创建流动医疗队。
一位负责官员引用称，对人道主义和职责号召的响应是“宏伟的”。来自世界各地的医疗物资、救护车和资金捐赠纷至沓来。医生、护士、敷料员、机械师和技术人员纷纷涌向内地的红十字会旗下服役。
在上海战斗的最初几周，外科小组在广州和香港组建，并紧急赶往战区以补充现有的医院工作人员。托德博士（Dr. Todd）率领一组经验丰富的外科医生。香港圣约翰救护队救护车主任A.莫里斯先生（Mr. A. Morris）组织了一个护理小组前往南京。像已故的S. C. H.博士这样的个人自愿提供服务。
来自海外的外国同情者和爱国华人团体离开了舒适和安全的环境，前来服务于他们受苦的同胞。加拿大、美国、英国、德国、印度、澳大利亚和新西兰都派遣了各自的志愿者名额。像麦克卢尔（McClure）、格雷（Gray）、特里曼（Tremewan）、汉基（Hankwy）、波德古尔斯基（Podgurski）和陶特曼（Trautmann）等医生来到中国提供服务。旅居欧美各地的中国毕业生主动回国。北平协和医学院的教授、讲师和校友纷纷聚集在其同事、现任红十字会医疗队队长林可胜博士（Dr. Robert K. S. Lim）的旗帜下。来自全国各地的学生和合格护士均名列在册。

page_data.en:
April, 20, 1939.
Political news -B

Java sent a completely equipped unit (Java Overseas Chinese Ambulance Unit) of 20 doctors and dressers, with nine motor ambulances and large quantities of medical supplies. Funds were also collected from all over Java to support another eight operative units for one year. Penang was not neglectful of practical help to China. Forty first-aid men were sent to swell the numbers of volunteers. After undergoing intensive training they were sent to the front. From Sumatra came a group of expert motor drivers and mechanics who joined the transportation department of the Red Cross Medical Corps. They brought with them a gift of three ambulances. The Indian National Congress Party sent an ambulance unit staffed by highly capable surgeons for work with the Red Cross.

To assure better co-ordination and co-operation with the Army Medical Service, the Red Cross Medical Corps worked out a new scheme of division of labour by which the latter supplied trained technical personnel to army hospitals.

Under the Corps are 89 units including 23 ambulance units, 23 nursing units, 24 curative units, six preventive units, 12 transportation units and an X-ray unit. Each of the transportation units commands five ambulances, while the X-ray unit is equipped with 20 X-ray machines and generators.

To assist the Army Medical Service in the region between the front and the base hospital area, the mobile medical units of dressers, nurses and doctors staff the receiving stations and the hospital trains and boats so as to take continuous care of the wounded during the long journey from the front to the rear.

The role of the medical units in the rear of the lines of communication is to supplement the medical staff of the army field and base hospitals. This is done by attaching operating and nursing units to certain hospitals for the purpose of using these particular hospitals as surgical clearing houses for the treatment of the severely wounded in the various hospitals nearby. The Red Cross doctors and nurses come from among the best hospitals in the country, and through their attachment to the army hospitals they bring the best available technical help to them. By placing groups of these different kinds of units along the more important lines of communication leading from each major front, the Red Cross hopes to apply its aid in the most effective manner possible.

Supply depots and transport convoys are distributed along these same lines, serving the units, receiving stations and hospitals. Supplies are distributed to many military and civil war-time medical organizations besides the Red Cross units. Similarly, transportation is from time to time provided for other medical organizations than the Red Cross.

To ease the difficulty of transporting bulk medical supplies from place to place, the transportation department of the Corps has instituted standard packages. They are so designed that two of them can be strapped to the back of a carrier and transported long distances without causing undue hardship. The average weight per package is about 40 pounds or 19 kilogrammes. The contents are so carefully selected that the essential drugs, necessary dressing and operating equipments are all included.

In addition to serving wounded soldiers in army establishments, the Red Cross has also organized preventive units which work among refugees, and also help in the work of epidemic prevention among various sections of the population and the army camps in their vicinity. Red Cross units are instructed to render first aid to victims of air raids. In most places where these units are stationed, special dressing stations and temporary hospitalization have been organized for the care of air-raid casualties. A picture of wartime Red Cross activity in China would be incomplete without mention of the magnificent work performed by the International Committees formed in the early days of the war and granted special charters from the National Red Cross Society of China.--China News & Views Digest.

page_data.zh:
1939年4月20日。
政治新闻 -B

爪哇派遣了一支装备齐全的队伍（爪哇华侨救护队），包括20名医生和敷料员，九辆机动救护车以及大量医疗物资。爪哇各地还筹集了资金，以支持另外八个手术队一年的运作。槟城也没有忽视对中国的实际援助。四十名急救人员被派去充实志愿者队伍。经过强化训练后，他们被派往前线。来自苏门答腊的一群专业汽车司机和机械师加入了红十字会医疗队的运输部门。他们还带来了三辆救护车作为礼物。印度国大党派遣了一支由能力出众的外科医生组成的救护队，与红十字会一同工作。

为了确保与陆军医务处更好地协调与合作，红十字会医疗队制定了一套新的分工方案，由后者向军队医院提供受过训练的技术人员。

该医疗队下辖89个分队，包括23个救护队、23个护理队、24个治疗队、6个防疫队、12个运输队和1个X光队。每个运输队配备五辆救护车，而X光队则配备了20台X光机和发电机。

为了协助陆军医务处在前线与后方基地医院区域之间的工作，由敷料员、护士和医生组成的流动医疗队在接收站以及医院列车和船只上服务，以便在伤员从前线到后方的漫长旅途中提供持续的照料。

后勤通讯线后方的医疗队的作用是补充军队野战医院和基地医院的医务人员。这是通过将手术队和护理队附属于某些医院来实现的，目的是将这些特定医院用作外科分流中心，以治疗附近各医院的重伤员。红十字会的医生和护士来自全国最好的医院，通过附属到军队医院，他们为军队医院提供了现有的最佳技术援助。通过在从各主要前线引出的更重要的交通线上部署各类分队组合，红十字会希望以最有效的方式提供援助。

供应仓库和运输车队也分布在这些相同的交通线上，为各分队、接收站和医院提供服务。除了红十字会分队外，物资还分发给许多军事和民用战时医疗组织。同样，运输服务也不时提供给红十字会以外的其他医疗组织。

为了缓解大批量医疗物资从一个地方运往另一个地方的困难，该医疗队的运输部门实行了标准化包装。这些包装设计使得两个包装可以绑在背负者的背上，长距离运输而不会造成过度的负担。每个包装的平均重量约为40磅或19公斤。内容物经过精心挑选，包含了基本药物、必要的敷料和手术设备。

除了在军队机构中为受伤士兵提供服务外，红十字会还组织了在难民中工作的防疫队，并帮助在各阶层民众及其附近的军营中开展防疫工作。红十字会分队受命为空袭受害者提供急救。在这些分队驻扎的大多数地方，都设立了专门的敷料站和临时住院设施，以照顾空袭伤亡人员。如果不提及战争初期成立并获得中国红十字会特别章程授权的国际委员会所进行的卓越工作，那么对中国战时红十字会活动的描述将是不完整的。——《中国新闻与观点文摘》

page_data.en:
April, 20, 1939.
Political news -C
BUILDING SINO-FOREIGN RELATIONS ON CULTURAL BASIS

Not more than five weeks since the inauguration of the Sino-American Institute of Cultural Relations, a similar association was formed in Chungking on March 26 by a group of prominent Chinese and their French, Belgian and Swiss friends. It is the fifth organization of its kind established in recent years for the promotion of goodwill, peace and brotherhood through better understanding of the cultural backgrounds and achievements between China and the respective countries concerned.

Attended by many high Chinese government officials and foreign diplomatic officers and correspondents, including the Louvain-trained Minister of Economics, Dr. Wong Wen-hou, M. Guillaume Georges-Picot, Counsellor to the French Embassy, M. L. Louis Scheyven, Belgian Charge d'Affaires, M. and Madame Leon Simon, correspondent for L'Echo de Paris, M. Roger Pierard, Havas representative in Chungking and others, the Sino-French-Belgian-Swiss Cultural Association aiming at further cementing the cultural relations between China and the three peace-loving European countries was formally inaugurated in the Chinese wartime capital at a time when a closer tie between the nationals of the four countries in Europe and Asia is most urgently needed.

The birth of the Association was warmly welcomed by the Chinese. The official Central Daily News foresaw the dawn of another era in the cordial relations of China and the three European countries. "Everlasting Sino-foreign relations must be built on cultural foundations," said the daily. "France, Belgium and Switzerland are all peace-loving and democratic countries. They have many things in common. Although the three friendly nations in Europe have not been directly invaded, they are being constantly threatened by their powerful and ambitious neighbours whose sole aim is aggression and destruction of peace. Henceforth cultural co-operation between China and those countries as a prelude to future political collaborations is most opportune at this moment."

In an inaugural speech, Minister Wong Wen-hou expressed a hope that the creation of the Sino-French-Belgian-Swiss Cultural Association would further cement the relations of the four countries and would bring better understanding between the peace-loving peoples. Speaking on behalf of the French Ambassador, M. Henri Cosme, who was on his way to Shanghai, M. Georges-Picot said that the relationship between China and French has always been on a friendly basis and that even more cordial relations between the two countries may be expected through constant associations rendered possible by the formation of the new organization. "A new world is expected to be created," said M. Scheyven. "With China, France, Belgium and Switzerland collaborating culturally." M. Scheyven continued that the co-operation between the four countries was an important factor in promoting world civilization.

Following the speeches, officers were elected with Mr. Wu Chih-hui, member of the Central Supervisory Committee of the Chinese Nationalist Party, as the president of the Association. Mr. Wu, veteran Kuomintang member and a noted writer who was associated with Dr. Sun Yat-sen in London, was promoter of the Chinese student labour movement and of the Franco-China University at Lyons while in France. Among the seven honorary presidents elected were M. Edouard Herriot, former premier of France and M. Paul van Zeeland, former premier of Belgium, Mr. Ma Hsiang-po, the centenarian state councillor of the National Government; Mr. Chang Chi, who is a member of the Central Supervisory Committee. Among the 25 directors elected were Dr. Wang Ch'ung-hui, China's Foreign Minister; M. Henri Cosme, French Ambassador to China; Dr. Wellington Koo, China's Ambassador to France, Mr. Victor Hoo, China's Minister to Switzerland and Director of the Permanent office of the Chinese Delegation to the League of Nations.--Chungking Ta Kung Pao.

page_data.zh:
1939年4月20日。
政治新闻 -C
在文化基础上建立中外关系

中美文化协会成立不到五周，3月26日，一群杰出的中国人及其法国、比利时和瑞士朋友在重庆组建了一个类似的协会。这是近年来建立的第五个此类组织，旨在通过更好地了解中国与相关各国之间的文化背景和成就，促进善意、和平与兄弟情谊。

许多中国政府高官和外国外交官及记者出席了会议，其中包括曾在鲁汶大学受训的经济部长翁文灏博士、法国大使馆参赞纪佑穆先生 (M. Guillaume Georges-Picot)、比利时代办谢维恩先生 (M. L. Louis Scheyven)、《巴黎回声报》记者西蒙夫妇 (M. and Madame Leon Simon)、哈瓦斯社重庆代表皮亚尔先生 (M. Roger Pierard) 等。旨在进一步巩固中国与这三个爱好和平的欧洲国家之间文化关系的中法比瑞文化协会，在欧洲和亚洲四国国民之间迫切需要更紧密联系的关头，于中国战时首都正式成立。

该协会的诞生受到了中国人的热烈欢迎。官方《中央日报》预见中国与这三个欧洲国家的友好关系将迎来一个新的黎明。该报称：“永恒的中外关系必须建立在文化基础之上。法国、比利时和瑞士都是爱好和平的民主国家。它们有许多共同点。虽然这三个欧洲友好国家尚未直接遭受入侵，但它们不断受到强大且野心勃勃的邻国的威胁，这些邻国的唯一目标就是侵略和破坏和平。因此，此时中国与这些国家进行文化合作，作为未来政治协作的前奏，是最合时宜的。”

翁文灏部长在就职演说中表示，希望中法比瑞文化协会的成立能进一步巩固四国关系，并增进爱好和平的人民之间的相互了解。法国驻华大使高思默先生 (M. Henri Cosme) 正在前往上海的途中，纪佑穆先生代表他发言，表示中法关系一直建立在友好基础之上，并且通过新组织的成立使持续交往成为可能，两国关系有望更加融洽。谢维恩先生说：“随着中国、法国、比利时和瑞士在文化上的合作，一个新世界有望被创造出来。”谢维恩先生继续说，四国之间的合作是促进世界文明的重要因素。

演讲结束后，选举产生了协会职员，由中国国民党中央监察委员会委员吴稚晖先生担任协会会长。吴先生是资深国民党党员和著名作家，曾在伦敦与孙中山博士共事，在法国期间曾推动中国学生勤工俭学运动以及里昂中法大学的建立。当选的七位名誉主席中包括法国前总理赫里欧先生 (M. Edouard Herriot) 和比利时前总理范泽兰先生 (M. Paul van Zeeland)、国民政府百岁国府顾问马相伯先生、中央监察委员会委员张继先生。当选的25名董事中包括中国外交部长王宠惠博士、法国驻华大使高思默先生 (M. Henri Cosme)、中国驻法大使顾维钧博士、中国驻瑞士公使兼中国出席国际联盟代表团常设办事处主任胡世泽先生。——重庆《大公报》

page_data.en:
April, 20, 1939.
Press comment -A

THE WEAPON OF JUSTICE IS IN OUR HANDS
(Morning Leader, Shanghai, April 19)

Commenting on the threatening letters addressed to foreign-owned
Chinese dailies in Shanghai yesterday by traitors, who claimed to be
the 'China Youths' Patriotic Salvation Association', the Morning Leader
has the following to say:

"The contents of the threatening letter we received are not worthy
of even a laugh. The senders, self-styled 'patriots' are the proteges
of the Japanese. Yes, they do love their 'country', which is not the
Republic of China, but the one controlled by Japanese militarists. By
'salvation' they mean the salvation of Japanese militarism from its
imminent collapse.

"Since the very day when our paper came into being, we have been ready
to receive bombs or bullets, And they did visit us last year, but we
never took it seriously. Such mean and dastardly tactics could only
have been carried out by those who have betrayed their own soul.

"Of late, Japanese newspapers and the 'Sin Shun Pao', an organ of the
puppet regime in Nanking have been vigorously attacking the Chinese
press published in the foreign controlled areas here. They advocate that
such 'anti-Japanese' newspapers be 'chastized'.

"Because these foreign-owned Chinese newspapers have been advocat-
ing justice and constantly disclosing Japanese intrigues, they have naturally
become an eyesore to the Japanese. We did not know what measures they
would take to 'chastize' us until we received the letter yesterday which
threatened us with 'bombs' or 'bullets'. You, running dogs of the
'Yellow Way Society', had once threatened to set our office on fire. We
have witnessed many of your 'great deeds'. But we are sorry to say, it
is because of such 'great deeds' that we have decided to uphold justice
forever.

"The reason why the aggressor has recently exerted greater pressure
on Chinese newspapers is that the latter have been a serious obstacle to
the successful execution of its sinister intrigues in this country. The
treacherous moves of Wang Ching-wei, the ousted Kuomintang leader have
failed, largely due to the vigilant watch placed on him and his followers
by the Chinese press. That's why the aggressor wants to soften the atti-
tude of the Chinese press, so that there may be a chance for the traitors
to renew their activities.

"The aim of the aggressor is not only to suppress the newspapers
which uphold justice but also to oust all right-minded persons, both
Chinese and foreign, from Shanghai., so that only its slaves could remain
to listen to its preachings.

"We would like to tell the aggressor that this attempt is only a
daydream. Justice cannot be suppressed. No right-minded will yield to
threats or inducements. You have used airplanes, heavy guns, tanks, poison
gases, bombs and shell and resorted to rape, plunderage, incendiaryism and
other means unprecedented in cruelty, but you have not succeeded in
beating China to her knees.

"We firmly believe that the weapon of justice is in our hands. We
are not afraid of anything. Let's raise our torches and clear away all
the vicious and cowardly devils from our path."

1939年4月20日。
报刊评论 -A

正义的武器在我们手中
（上海《晨导报》，4月19日）

针对昨天汉奸以自称“中国青年救国会”的名义向在上海的外商中文日报发送恐吓信一事，《晨导报》发表如下评论：

“我们收到的恐吓信内容甚至不值一笑。发信人自称为‘爱国者’，实则是日本人的宠儿。是的，他们确实爱他们的‘国家’，但不是中华民国，而是由日本军国主义者控制的那个国家。他们所谓的‘救国’，是指挽救日本军国主义免于迫在眉睫的崩溃。

“自从本报创刊之日起，我们就已准备好迎接炸弹或子弹。去年它们确实光顾过我们，但我们从未将其当真。这种卑鄙懦弱的伎俩只能由那些出卖自己灵魂的人干得出来。

“最近，日本报纸和南京傀儡政权的机关报《新顺报》一直在猛烈攻击在此间外国控制区出版的中文报刊。他们鼓吹要‘惩戒’这些‘反日’报纸。

“因为这些外商中文报纸一直倡导正义，不断揭露日本的阴谋，自然成了日本人的眼中钉。直到昨天收到威胁要用‘炸弹’或‘子弹’对付我们的信件之前，我们不知道他们会采取什么措施来‘惩戒’我们。你们这些‘黄道会’的走狗，曾经威胁要烧毁我们的办公室。我们见识过你们的许多‘壮举’。但很遗憾地说，正是因为这样的‘壮举’，我们决定永远坚持正义。

“侵略者最近加大对中文报纸压力的原因是，后者严重阻碍了其在中国成功实施险恶阴谋。被开除的国民党领导人汪精卫的叛国举动之所以失败，很大程度上是由于中文报纸对他及其追随者的严密监视。这就是为什么侵略者想要软化中文报纸的态度，以便让汉奸有机会重新活动。

“侵略者的目的不仅是压制坚持正义的报纸，还要将所有正直的中外人士赶出上海，以便只留下其奴隶来聆听其说教。

“我们要告诉侵略者，这种企图只是白日梦。正义是无法压制的。没有哪个正直的人会屈服于威胁或利诱。你们使用了飞机、重炮、坦克、毒气、炸弹和炮弹，并采取了强奸、掠夺、纵火和其他前所未有的残酷手段，但你们未能迫使中国跪下。

“我们坚信，正义的武器在我们手中。我们无所畏惧。让我们举起火炬，清除道路上所有邪恶和懦弱的魔鬼。”

Name Price Buyer Quantity

NATURAL RESOURCES IN CHINA'S BACKDOOR PROVINCE

Kunming, March 31. (By mail) -- Serving as the main international link between China and the outside world, Yunnan Province is fast becoming the nation's leading economic unit.

Exporting over 85 percent of China's tin production which annually nets this southwestern frontier province $30,000,000, Yunnan today is keeping pace with Szechwan Province in developing its rich natural resources and starting new industries. It is to the vast economic possibilities of this province that world attention is now turned. From the South Seas alone, overseas Chinese have already decided to invest $50,000,000 for developing Yunnan into a thriving province; while financial and technical co-operation from foreign countries and concerns will also be forthcoming as means of communication are improved, according to the provincial authorities.

In the high tablelands of this cloudy province of Yunnan are found some of the nation's richest mineral deposits. Lead, tin, copper, salt, iron, zinc and silver are abundant everywhere and the coal produced from one Yunnan district alone is not only supplying the needs of the Kunming-Haiphong railway but is also selling in French Indo-China. The annual coal output from Yunnan is being increased from its present production of 750,000 tons.

China contributes about 70 percent of the world's total production of antimony. Besides, she supplies 40 percent of the world's total output of tungsten. Excepting Hunan and Kiangsi provinces, Yunnan is the largest producing centre of these metals in China. At present, the antimony-tungsten development company of the Yunnan Finance Department is monopolizing the mining and marketing of these mineral products which are enjoying a very high demand due to the armament race in various parts of the world.

Copper is produced in more than 80 out of some 100 districts of Yunnan Province which is the richest and the oldest producing centre of this metal in China. At one time the province annually produced more than 3,000 tons of copper. The provincial authorities are trying to maintain at least this maximum production level for the next few years. In striking

经济新闻 -1

中国后方省份的自然资源

昆明，3月31日。（邮寄）——作为中国与外界联系的主要国际通道，云南省正迅速成为全国领先的经济单位。

云南出口了中国锡产量的85%以上，每年为这个西南边陲省份带来3,000,000美元的净收入。如今，云南在开发其丰富的自然资源和兴办新工业方面，正与四川省并驾齐驱。世界的目光现在正转向该省巨大的经济潜力。仅来自南洋的华侨已决定投资5,000,000美元，将云南建设成为一个繁荣的省份；据省政府当局称，随着交通条件的改善，外国及外商的资金和技术合作也将随之而来。

在这个云雾缭绕的云南省的高原上，蕴藏着一些全国最丰富的矿藏。铅、锡、铜、盐、铁、锌和银随处可见，仅云南一个地区生产的煤炭不仅满足了滇越铁路的需求，还销往法属印度支那。云南的年煤炭产量正从目前的750,000吨逐步增加。

中国的锑产量约占世界总产量的70%。此外，中国供应了世界钨总产量的40%。除湖南和江西省外，云南是中国这些金属的最大生产中心。目前，云南省财政厅下属的锑钨开发公司垄断着这些矿产品的开采和销售，由于世界各地的军备竞赛，这些矿产品需求极高。

在云南全省约100个县中，有80多个县出产铜，云南是中国该金属最丰富且历史最悠久的生产中心。该省曾有一段时间年产铜超过3,000吨。省政府当局正试图在未来几年内至少维持这一最高生产水平。与之形成鲜明对比的是

page_data.en:

contrast with its neighbour province of Kweichow which produces very little
salt, Yunnan is a big salt-supplying centre. Its production of this
important commodity has been increased from 595,900 quintals in 1933 to
959,100 quintals in 1937.

According to the statistics of the provincial reconstruction depart-
ment, Yunnan, which has an area of 320,051 square kilometres and 12,000,000
inhabitants, has some 700,000 acres of uncultivated land. Over 45 percent
of the adults are farmers. Only 12 percent are labourers and 3 percent
are merchants. Hence as far as the occupations of the natives are concerned,
Yunnan is largely agricultural and its farm produce is usually sufficient
for domestic consumption. The reconstruction department reported that in
1938 Yunnan produced 34,312,376 quintals of rice, 2,305,672 quintals of
wheat, 1,860,129 quintals of barley, 14,770,863 quintals of corn, 3,969,804
quintals of peas, 10,661,913 quintals of potatoes. Through the complete
eradication of poppy cultivation from Yunnan at the end of last year, the
provincial authorities expect that farm products will increase by at least
25 percent over the previous annual levels. In many of the fertile fields
were opium once grew scientific plantation of cotton has been introduced.

Throughout mountainous Yunnan Province are found many forests. Palms,
caoutchouc, cactus and fir-trees are abundant in the valleys and along
the ravines. The province's 133 forestry bureaus have altogether more than
3,900 reforestation areas covering some 1,350,000 acres of land. The whole
province has more than 1,600,000 acres of well-wooded mountainous regions
on which are largely grown pines and cedars.

Yunnan, because of its climate, topography and soil is ideal for cattle-
raising. Thousands of cattle are grazed on the abundant open green pastures.
The export of animal and animal products usually nets the Yunnanese many
million dollars. Most part of Yunnan Province is on a plateau; there are
many fresh water lakes where fish and marine products abound. It has been
estimated that Yunnan which has over 4,400 registered fishermen annually
produces more than 2,752,000 catties of fish alone.
page_data.zh:
经济新闻 -2

其邻省贵州产盐极少，而云南则是一个重要的食盐供应中心。这种重要商品的产量已从1933年的595,900担增加到1937年的959,100担。

根据省建设厅的统计，面积为320,051平方公里、人口12,000,000的云南，拥有约700,000英亩未开垦土地。成年人中超过45%是农民。只有12%是劳工，3%是商人。因此，就当地居民的职业而言，云南主要以农业为主，其农产品通常足以满足国内消费。建设厅报告称，1938年云南生产大米34,312,376担，小麦2,305,672担，大麦1,860,129担，玉米14,770,863担，豌豆3,969,804担，土豆10,661,913担。通过在去年年底彻底铲除云南境内的罂粟种植，省政府当局预计农产品将比往年水平至少增加25%。在许多曾经种植鸦片的肥沃田野里，已引入了科学的棉花种植。

在多山的云南省各地分布着许多森林。山谷和沟壑沿线盛产棕榈、橡胶、仙人掌和冷杉。该省的133个林业局共有3,900多个造林区，覆盖土地约1,350,000英亩。全省拥有超过1,600,000英亩林木茂密的山区，主要生长松树和雪松。

云南因其气候、地形和土壤条件，理想适合养牛。成千上万的牛群在广阔的绿色牧场上放牧。牲畜及畜产品的出口通常为云南人带来数百万美元的收入。云南省大部分地区位于高原之上；那里有许多淡水湖泊，鱼类和水产品丰富。据估计，云南拥有4,400多名注册渔民，每年仅鱼类产量就超过2,752,000斤。

Of the Yunnan products, perhaps none can beat its ham and P'ueul tea
in popularity. Every year more than 40,000,000 catties of P'ueul tea and

of sugar and tens of thousands of catties of medicinal plants are marketed
domestically and internationally. These products, together with its
mineral exports, are responsible for the favourable trade balance of

One Greek steamship and one Norwegian steamship were detained by

with the Japanese authorities as soon as detailed reports are received from

据本报从当地海关高级外籍官员处获得的报告，在1938年7月至1939年3月的过去九个月期间，上海征收的关税收入共计一亿元已存入日本横滨正金银行。——《新闻报》，4月20日。
* * *
两艘外轮在福建附近被日军扣留
据航运界在此收到的报告，昨日，一艘希腊轮船和一艘挪威轮船在福建沿海被日本海军当局扣留。
一旦收到来自福州关于扣押这些船只的详细报告，驻此地的希腊和挪威总领事将立即向日本当局提出强烈抗议。——《新闻报》，4月20日。
* * *
重庆成立国货审查委员会
据消息灵通的商界在此收到的报告，为了帮助商人区分国货与日货，经济部最近组织了一个国货审查委员会。
被任命为委员会委员的有金问洙博士（Kinn Wei Shaw，音译）、吴震洛先生、胡博渊先生、曾培良先生和欧阳伦先生。——《新闻报》，4月20日。
* * *
青岛新建日本棉纺厂停工
重庆，4月19日 - 据在此收到的报告，日本当局下令停止青岛几家新建日本棉纺厂的施工。同时，胶济铁路（青岛-济南）钢桥的修复工作也被下令推迟。然而，对于山东日本当局的这一突然决定，并未给出任何理由。——《文汇报》，4月20日。

page_data.en:
Extreme-Orient.
January, 1940

Page 12

THE AXIS RACKET.

In the month of August, 1937, Major Gerard,
Commissioner of the Shanghai Municipal Police, calmly took
his holiday in Japan notwithstanding the peril that was
threatening Shanghai.

On August 14, Chinese bombs---not Japanese bombs
as the propaganda of certain cliques would have us believe--
fell upon Shanghai. Four thousand Chinese victims and some
twenty foreigners were laid out in their blood, horribly
mutilated, on Nanking Road and Avenue Edward VII.

For many days, foreigners in Tsingtao were kept
in a state of alarm. When the attack on Shanghai started,
men and women and a number of officials were unable to
return to Shanghai. Eventually, those whose presence in
Shanghai was necessary, such as police officers, doctors,
volunteers and the writer of these lines in his capacity
of a journalist, were able to secure , without difficulty,
permission and the means to return to Shanghai.

Thus it was that we disembarked on the French Bund
at about 9 p.m. on August 19. On board the B. and S.
steamer which brought us here were one hundred men, mostly
Police officers and volunteers, of whom about a dozen were
French citizens.

Only, Major Gerard returned to Shanghai in October.
He was unable, the poor man, to find a way to return to his
post. He has since left us............Many thanks.

This preamble is necessary to elucidate what is to
follow.

In 1938, a group of French and other foreign
nationals, all well known and respected, conceived the
page_data.zh:
《远东》。
1940年1月

第12页

轴心国的勾当。

1937年8月，上海公共租界工部局警务处处长杰拉德（Gerard）少校不顾上海面临的危险，平静地去日本度假。

8月14日，中国炸弹——并非某些派系宣传让我们相信的日本炸弹——落在上海。四千名中国受害者和约二十名外国人血肉模糊、肢体残缺地陈尸于南京路和爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）。

许多天来，青岛的外国人一直处于惊恐状态。当对上海的袭击开始时，男女和一些官员无法返回上海。最终，那些必须出现在上海的人，如警察、医生、志愿者以及以记者身份撰写本文的作者，都毫不费力地获得了返回上海的许可和手段。

就这样，我们在8月19日晚上9点左右在法国外滩登陆。载我们到此的 B. and S. 轮船上有大约一百人，大多是警察和志愿者，其中约有十几人是法国公民。

只是，杰拉德少校直到10月才回到上海。这个可怜的人，找不到办法回到他的岗位。此后他便离开了我们............多谢。

这段前言对于阐明下文是必要的。

1938年，一群法国和其他外籍人士，都是知名且受尊敬的人物，构思了

page_data.en:
idea of starting in Shanghai a small taxis transportation
enterprise similar to that to be found everywhere except in
Shanghai, the "Model Settlement." The large taxis are
comfortable but much too large for the transportation of
a single fare. For a ride of less than 20 minutes, the fare
used to be $1 plus a tip of 20 cents.

The promoters of the small taxis enterprise were
in a position to place on the streets comfortable and fast
little vehicles of Austin or Cabilla or Simca make. Fitted
with a meter, the average fare would be about 40 cents
without tip. Now, if anyone can think of an idea whose
realization would have been of greater public interest than
that, we would like to hear of it!

In France and in every other civilized country,
a business enterprise is established purely and simply at
the risk of the promoters. But Shanghai, as everyone knows,
is a "Model Settlement", an astonishing place, the Paris of
the East (thank you!) and other imbecile expressions of
this sort. On this account, one scarcely has the right to
smoke his pipe without having first to secure the permission
of the authorities of the Foreign Settlements.

In the case of the small taxis enterprise, it
was not possible to form a company without the "advance
permission" of the authorities of the French Concession and
the International Settlement.

But let us be fair. (We believe in rendering
to Caesar the things that are Caesar's). The application
of the promoters of the small taxis enterprise was accepted
by the French Municipal Administration with the right to
station these small but convenient vehicles at certain spots
designated by the Police, especially along the French Bund,
at the end of Avenue Edward VII., to the west of the Concession,
Avenue Petain, Avenue Joffre etc. at hours when people are
going to or returning from their offices.
page_data.zh:
在上海创办一家小型出租车运输企业的想法，这种企业在除上海这个“模范租界”以外的各地随处可见。大型出租车虽然舒适，但对于运送单个乘客来说太大了。对于少于20分钟的行程，车费通常是1元加上2角小费。

小型出租车企业的发起人有能力将奥斯汀（Austin）、卡比拉（Cabilla）或西姆卡（Simca）品牌的舒适快捷的小型车辆投放街头。装有计价器，平均车费约为4角，不含小费。现在，如果有人能想到一个比这更具公共利益的想法，我们愿闻其详！

在法国和每一个其他文明国家，商业企业的建立纯粹简单地由发起人承担风险。但是，众所周知，上海是一个“模范租界”，一个令人惊讶的地方，东方的巴黎（谢谢！）以及其他此类愚蠢的表达。因此，人们几乎没有权利在不先获得外国租界当局许可的情况下抽烟斗。

就小型出租车企业而言，如果没有法租界和公共租界当局的“预先许可”，就不可能成立公司。

但让我们公平一点。（我们相信凯撒的归凯撒）。小型出租车企业发起人的申请被法公董局接受，有权将这些虽小但便利的车辆停放在警察指定的某些地点，特别是沿着法国外滩、爱多亚路西端、租界西部、贝当路（Avenue Petain）、霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）等，在人们上下班的时间段。

page_data.en:
-3-

Thus, people could go to their work in a few
minutes in new and clean taxis at a maximum fare of 20 cents
per head.

That was the dream. But Major Gerard and his friends
were on watch.

One would have thought that the administration of
the International Settlement would have followed the example
of the French Municipal Administration with some eagerness.
Not at all!

The taxi enterprises already in existence regarded
with a malevolent eye the creation of an organization which
might become a competitor. These enterprises had come into
existence by means of a process that was grotesque and peculiar
to Shanghai. Should one desire a vehicle one has to telephone
to the garage instead of going to one of the taxi stands, as
would be the case in any other part of the world.

What is called "public authority" should, in
principle, be exercised in the interests of the general public,
that of more than a million persons before that of certain
combines and of what is called on the other side of Avenue
Edward VII. "the sacred vested interests." Nothing of the
sort!

"Vested interests" first and above everything else,
pals before anybody else; to the devil with the pigs of payers,
the ratepayer and the public!

In short, the application for permission to place
small taxis on the streets in the International Settlement
was rejected by the Shanghai Municipal Council on an
unfavourable report made by Major Gerard who stated ( vide the
newspapers of those days):

1) that the small taxis would aggravate the congestion
of the streets (!)

2). that the small taxis enterprise would not prove
profitable to its promoters (!!!)

It is impossible to imagine a more ridiculous and
insolent reply or pretexts.
page_data.zh:
-3-

这样，人们就可以乘坐崭新干净的出租车，以每人最多2角的车费，在几分钟内去上班。

那是梦想。但杰拉德少校和他的朋友们在监视着。

人们可能会认为公共租界当局会急切地效仿法公董局的做法。完全不是！

现有的出租车企业带着恶意的眼光看待一个可能成为竞争对手的组织的创建。这些企业是通过一种滑稽且上海特有的过程得以存在的。如果想用车，人们必须打电话给车库，而不是像在世界其他地方那样去出租车候客站。

所谓“公共权力”原则上应为广大公众的利益行使，即为一百多万人的利益，而非为某些集团以及在爱多亚路另一边所谓的“神圣既得利益者”的利益。事实并非如此！

“既得利益”第一且高于一切，哥们儿优先；让付钱的人、纳税人和公众见鬼去吧！

总之，在公共租界街道放置小型出租车的许可申请，基于杰拉德少校所作的不利报告，被上海工部局董事会拒绝，他声称（参见当时的报纸）：

1) 小型出租车会加剧街道拥堵 (!)

2). 小型出租车企业对发起人来说无利可图 (!!!)

无法想象还有比这更荒谬和无礼的回答或借口。

page_data.en:
-1-

Is there any need to say that the 20,000 wretched
and prehistoric rickshas and the 100,000 hand drawn vehicles
which at all hours of the day obstruct the streets of the
International Settlement are more clumsy and cumbersome than
one hundred small taxis one of which takes up no more space
than a ricksha.

Nor is there any need to say that the pretext given
by Major Gerard on the financial aspect of the enterprise
has nothing to do with him.

But there were pals to be considered.

Examine now the list of the Directors of the taxi
companies in the Hong List and then turn to the list of
members of the Shanghai Municipal Council of that time.

Do not catch a headache---but draw your own
conclusions.
page_data.zh:
-1-

是否有必要说，那两万辆可怜且过时的黄包车和十万辆人力车，全天候阻塞着公共租界的街道，比一百辆小型出租车更加笨拙和累赘，而其中一辆小型出租车所占的空间并不比一辆黄包车多。

也没有必要说，杰拉德少校就该企业财务方面给出的借口与他无关。

但是要考虑哥们儿。

现在查看《鸿名录》（Hong List）中出租车公司董事的名单，然后转向当时上海工部局董事会成员的名单。

不要想得头痛——但要得出你自己的结论。

page_data.en:
Extreme-Orient.
January, 1940.

Page 10.

THE CHINESE COURTS.

( The article deals with corruption in local Chinese
Courts and has probably been inspired by another article
published in "Oriental Affairs", Pages 46 and 47, issue
of December, 1939, in the course of which the following
passage occurred:-"Judges who did not squeeze the
litigants were extremely rare." )

----------

Do not imagine that these undesirable practices
are to be found only on the other side of Sikawei Creek.
We have unceasingly declared and affirmed that they are still
going on and that it is impossible to obtain judgment in any
cases in which large sums of money are involved without
having the scales of justice tampered with.

One would have thought that the Chinese Courts in
the First and Second Districts of Shanghai which had replaced
the former Mixed Courts , 12 years ago in the first case and
9 years ago in the second, would have registered some progress.

One would have likewise thought that the Magistrates
of these Courts would have, in honour bound, demonstrated to
foreigners that they were worthy of this change; that the
buildings would be well kept and more or less heated in
winter; that they would not permit the Court rooms, the
corridors and places for public convenience from being
converted into wretched spitting places with loose talk
going on, accompanied by noises of belchings, the clearing
of throats and incessant expectorations; that they would
show some measure of courtesy to litigants or lawyers of
foreign nationality; and above all, that they will show
some semblance of impartiality.

Nothing of the kind!

Persons who are acquainted with the former Chinese
Courts know that the dignitaries of the old days, such as
page_data.zh:
远东。
1940年1月。

第10页。

中国法院。

（本文论述中国地方法院的腐败问题，其灵感可能源自1939年12月刊《东方事务》（"Oriental Affairs"）第46和47页上发表的另一篇文章，该文中曾出现如下段落：“不向诉讼当事人敲榨勒索的法官极为罕见。”）

----------

不要以为这些不良行径仅见于徐家汇河对岸。我们已不断声明并确认，此类行径仍在继续，且在涉及巨额款项的任何案件中，若不操纵司法天平，便不可能获得判决。

人们或许会认为，上海第一和第二特区中国法院——前者于12年前、后者于9年前取代了原有的会审公廨——应当已取得某些进步。

人们同样会认为，这些法院的推事们出于荣誉责任，应向外国人证明他们配得上这一变革；法院建筑应得到良好维护，并在冬季提供一定程度的供暖；他们不应允许法庭、走廊及公共便利场所沦为肮脏的随地吐痰之地，伴随着闲言碎语、打嗝声、清嗓子声以及不断的吐痰声；他们应对具有外国国籍的诉讼当事人或律师表现出一定的礼貌；尤其是，他们应展现出某种公正的样子。

然而事实并非如此！

熟悉旧式中国法院的人都知道，昔日的显贵人物，例如

page_data.en:
-2-

the Taotai of Shanghai who still sat in the Appeal Court
a short time before the other judges were out, were capable
of demonstrating their great breadth of ideas and that they
were worthy magistrates. Foreign firms who had cases before
these Judges were certain of winning their cases if they
were in the right.

But nothing of this is to be seen today.

A foreign complainant today has only a very slim
chance of obtaining justice in the Chinese Courts. In the
first place, nobody listens to him, while his opponent can
talk to his heart's content. Furthermore, it will be with
extreme difficulty that a foreign complainant can have his
witnesses heard or his case submitted.

In a recent issue, we cited a case in which a
Judge of the First District Court deliberately refused to
hear witnesses of the prosecution----members of the Shanghai
Municipal Police----so that the Judge could avoid passing
sentence on the accused who was eventually acquitted.

In the civil cases that have come before the
First or Second District Court, all the Chinese defendants
have been successful, to the mortification of the foreign
complainants, notwithstanding the fact that the defendants
were in the wrong.

Here are a few examples:-

The Shanghai Tug and Lighter Co. sued a Chinese
broker in the Second District Court (French Concession) for
breach of contract. That the contract had been broken by
the defendant, there was no question of a doubt, nor was
there any doubt over the fact that the complainants had
sustained a serious loss. But what did it matter; the Chinese
defendant won the case.

A French citizen sued four well known Chinese
merchants for payment of commission for service rendered.
The defendants, although summoned, took matters coolly.
After some unavoidable delay, the Court of First Instance
page_data.zh:
-2-

上海道台，在其他法官离任前不久仍坐堂于上诉法院，他们能够展示其宏大的见识，且是称职的推事。在这些法官面前有案件的外国商行，只要理据充分，必胜诉无疑。

但如今已看不到这种情况。

如今，外国原告在中国法院获得正义的机会微乎其微。首先，无人倾听他的陈述，而他的对手则可以随心所欲地侃侃而谈。此外，外国原告极难使其证人获准作证或使其案件得以受理。

在近期的一期中，我们引用了一个案例，其中第一特区法院的一名法官故意拒绝听取控方证人——即上海公共租界工部局警务处成员——的证词，以便该法官避免对被告作出判决，被告最终被宣告无罪释放。

在提交至第一或第二特区法院的民事案件中，尽管被告理亏，所有中国被告均胜诉，令外国原告深感屈辱。

以下是几个例子：

上海拖轮驳船公司（Shanghai Tug and Lighter Co.）在第二特区法院（法租界）起诉一名中国经纪人违约。被告违反合同一事毫无疑问，原告遭受严重损失的事实也毋庸置疑。但这又有何妨；中国被告赢得了官司。

一名法国公民起诉四名知名中国商人，要求支付服务佣金。被告虽被传唤，却态度冷淡。经过一些不可避免的延误后，初审法院

page_data.en:
-3-
gave judgment by default for the payment of the sums claimed.
The defendants did not appeal, although they had the right to
do so. It was only when the judgment was served on them that
they petitioned for a re-trial.
Now a re-trial is permitted only when new facts
unknown to the defendants and which they could have made use
of, had arisen since the delivery of the judgment. The
defendants, in asking for a re-trial, were pleading what they
should have pleaded in the first instance. Their defence had
no leg to stand on.
The Judge, if he had been worthy of the name,
should have over-ruled the application for a re-trial on
the ground that they had brought their action wrongfully and
in violation of the Code of Procedure over the question of a
re-trial.
But the Judge did not do this. It was a
question of giving face to the defendants who knew how to
go about it behind the scenes. Eventually the judgment
of the Court of First Instance was annulled in favour of
the Chinese defendants. The French citizen appealed. Judge
Hsia presided over the proceedings.
It was explained to the Court that a re-trial
could be ordered only when new facts had been discovered.
There were, however, no new facts, and on this point all
the parties were agreed. But that went for nothing for
the Court confirmed the judgment of the Court of First
Instance (?) and refused to hear the French complainant.
Are further examples needed? It is common
knowledge that a Judge of the Second District Court in
August, by an extraordinary chance, gave judgment for a
foreign complainant over a difference in a question of
rentals. The Court declared that a landlord amenable to
Chinese law can not insist on the payment of rents in
foreign currency nor determine a lease in order to insist
page_data.zh:
-3-
作出缺席判决，命令支付所索赔的款项。被告虽有权上诉，但未提出上诉。直到判决书送达给他们时，他们才申请重审。
然而，只有在判决作出后出现了被告此前未知且本可利用的新事实时，才允许重审。被告在申请重审时提出的抗辩理由，本应在初审时提出。他们的辩护站不住脚。
如果法官称职，本应以被告错误提起诉讼并违反关于重审问题的《诉讼法》为由，驳回重审申请。
但法官并未这样做。这是一个给被告面子的问题，而这些被告懂得如何在幕后运作。最终，初审判决被撤销，以利于中国被告。该法国公民提出上诉。夏法官（Judge Hsia，音译）主持了审理程序。
向法院解释说，只有在发现新事实的情况下才能命令重审。然而，并不存在新事实，各方对此点均无异议。但这毫无作用，法院维持了初审法院的判决（？）并拒绝听取法国原告的陈述。
还需要更多例子吗？众所周知，第二特区法院的一名法官在八月份，出于极偶然的机会，在一起租金纠纷案件中判决外国原告胜诉。法院宣布，受中国法律约束的房东不能坚持要求以外币支付租金，也不能为坚持这种支付方式而解除租赁契约。

page_data.en:
-4-
on this method of payment.
The Chinese defendant, who was an influential
person, appealed. The Court nullified the first judgment
so as to give satisfaction to the Chinese appellant.
In a similar case in the First District Court,
the same tactics were adopted. Here again the foreigner
was over-ruled.
Then there was the fantastic case of the Silk-
asis ( a French concern ) against the Chinese firm of
Chooling Co. It was on the eve of the rendition of the
French Mixed Court. The Chinese company had misappro-
priated certain goods belonging to the French Co. As the
directors of the Chinese company had taken to flight,
judgment was given against the defendants by default for
the payment of the amount due.
Unfortunately, a short time later, the French
Mixed Court was restored to the Nanking Government
without an inventory of the dossiers being taken. Very
soon, the Court cancelled the warrants of arrest issued
against the Chinese directors who had taken to flight.
The latter lost no time in returning to Shanghai. Since
then one has tried in vain to prevail upon the new Court
authorities to execute the judgment of the Mixed Court
although it was stipulated at the time of the rendition
of the Court. It was all wasted labour. The "dossiers"
had disappeared. The French company failed to secure
the smallest scrap of justice and had to go into
liquidation as a result of the losses it had sustained.
Such is the judicial administration in the
fifth largest port in the world.
China, or at least a great part of this vast
country which has had such a wonderful civilization and
is worthy of a great future, will very soon undergo a
page_data.zh:

身为有影响力人物的中国被告提出上诉。法院撤销了原判，以满足中国上诉人的要求。
在第一特区法院的一起类似案件中，采取了同样的策略。在此案中，外国人再次被驳回。
此外还有丝光公司（Silk-asis，一家法国企业）起诉中国公司聚林公司（Chooling Co.，音译）的离奇案件。当时正值法租界会审公廨移交前夕。这家中国公司侵吞了属于该法国公司的某些货物。由于中国公司的董事已潜逃，法院对被告作出缺席判决，命令支付欠款。
不幸的是，不久之后，法租界会审公廨在未编制案卷清单的情况下移交给南京政府。很快，法院取消了对潜逃的中国董事发出的逮捕令。后者随即返回上海。此后，人们徒劳地试图促使新的法院当局执行会审公廨的判决，尽管在法院移交时已有规定。这一切都是徒劳。“案卷”已消失无踪。这家法国公司未能获得丝毫正义，并因遭受的损失而被迫清算。
这就是世界第五大港口的司法行政状况。
中国，或者至少是这个拥有辉煌文明、值得拥有伟大未来的广袤国家的大部分区域，即将经历一场

page_data.en:
-5-
profound transformation.
Let us hope that under the aegis of a man who
has given proof of being a statesman whose independence
is well known and whose intelligence is beyond compare,
with the assistance of the learned Dr. Tsu Ving Gee,
revived China will understand her true dignity and
realize where her true interests lie.
page_data.zh:
-5-
深刻的变革。
让我们希望，在一位已证明自己是独立性强、智慧无与伦比的政治家的人的庇护下，并在朱炳桂博士（Dr. Tsu Ving Gee，音译）的协助下，复兴后的中国将理解其真正的尊严，并认识到其真正的利益所在。

Extreme-Orient.
January, 1940.

Page 27

A "Chauffard."

The European driver of motor car No. 7679 is a
"chauffard" who will one day receive the lesson he deserves.
Dashing up from the end of a line, he would amuse
himself by "going limp" and pull up his "horse cart" at
the risk of causing an accident.
Should he do this again, somebody whom I know will
teach him, at his expense, the principles of the rule of
the road.
A word to the wise is sufficient!

----------

Page 28

The New Roxy Cinema.

The "Wizard of Oz", which is being shown at this
cinema, is playing to full houses. The picture is certainly
a masterpiece. As for the cinema hall itself, it is a
different matter.
We ask, and as a matter of fact, everybody is
asking, how the Fire Brigade came to pass the inadequate
number of exits in the International Settlement. People
on the upper floor can only walk down the narrow and
sinuous stairs at a slow pace and should a catastrophe
occur, one trembles to imagine what the consequences
might be.

远东。
1940年1月。

第27页

一个“马路杀手”。

7679号汽车的欧洲司机是个“马路杀手”（chauffard），他总有一天会受到应有的教训。
他从车队末尾猛冲上来，以此为乐，故意“软趴趴”地驾驶，并在可能引发事故的风险下刹住他的“马车”。
如果他再这样做，我认识的一位人士将让他自掏腰包，学习交通规则的原则。
明人不必细说！

----------

第28页

新罗克西电影院。

该影院正在上映的《绿野仙踪》（"Wizard of Oz"）场场爆满。这部影片确是一部杰作。至于电影院大厅本身，则是另一回事。
我们询问，事实上每个人都在问，消防队是如何在国际租界通过验收那数量不足的出口通道的。楼上的人只能沿着狭窄曲折的楼梯缓慢下行，一旦发生灾难，后果不堪设想，令人不寒而栗。

COMMUNISM IN CHINA

There are still a number of foolish people
who say that there never has been communism in China.
In their opinion, there are no red armies, notwithstanding
all that a number of observers, have described with great
accuracy. Amongst these writers are Edgar Snow, J. Belden,
the Correspondent of the "Shanghai Evening Post" and Mr.
Yakonteff the author of the remarkable book "The Soviets
in China".

To these foolish people the Sian Coup of

and nearly lost his life, is probably a dream and all that
Chiang Kai-shek and his wife had written about the affair
in the "Revue de Paris" in March, 1938 had been drawn
from imagination.

The other day we found among some papers a
document the author of which, M. Marc Chadourne, is now
in Shanghai.

On August 4, 1931, the "Petit Parisien"
published a very interesting article written by M. Chadourne
on a voyage which he had made to China. This was one of
the best reports on conditions in China that has ever been
written.

To those who consider that Gallens alias

Morheste who used to declare that there was not even a

第5页

中国的共产主义

仍有一些愚蠢的人声称中国从未有过共产主义。在他们看来，尽管许多观察家已极其准确地描述了红军的存在，但红军并不存在。在这些作家中，包括埃德加·斯诺（Edgar Snow）、J.贝尔登（J. Belden，《上海晚邮报》记者）以及《苏维埃在中国》（"The Soviets in China"）一书的作者亚孔特夫先生（Mr. Yakonteff）。

对这些愚蠢的人来说，1936年12月的西安事变——当时蒋介石被红军俘虏并险些丧命——大概只是一场梦，而蒋介石及其夫人在1938年3月《巴黎评论》（"Revue de Paris"）上就该事件所写的一切均属虚构。

前几天，我们在一些文件中找到了一份文件，其作者马克·查杜尔纳先生（M. Marc Chadourne）目前在上海。

1931年8月4日，《小巴黎人报》（"Petit Parisien"）刊登了查杜尔纳先生撰写的一篇关于其中国之行的非常有趣的文章。这是迄今为止有关中国状况的最佳报道之一。

对于那些认为加伦（Gallens，又名布柳赫尔 Blucher）、鲍罗廷（Borodin）和亚戈夫（Yagov）——这些见证蒋介石政权诞生的人物——从未存在过的人——其中最有名的怀疑论者是莫赫斯特先生（Mr. Morheste，音译），他曾宣称中国连共产主义的痕迹都没有，那只是日本为证明其军事行动正当性而编造的妖怪——值得转载以下发表于1931年8月4日《小巴黎人报》上、由如今就在我们中间的查杜尔纳署名的段落。
以下是蒋介石发表的一项声明：“我们已消灭敌人并达成目标，这一成功的荣誉很大程度上归于我们的同志，苏联俄国人。中国革命的胜利就是世界革命的胜利，进而也就是俄国革命的绝对胜利。反之，可以说，中国革命的失败就是世界革命的失败。现在，如果世界革命失败，那么俄国革命将毫无意义。”
对此，一位中国人对查杜尔纳说：“……你刚才听到的话是蒋介石在1925年11月7日于汕头发出你所列举的大屠杀信号前一年说的。为了不被忽视，他特意让这些话语由国民党执行委员会情报局发布并传播。
“……蒋介石是一个督军，是继段祺瑞和吴佩孚之后的最后一类督军，他是中国封建军阀主义的代表。他想要做的是将5亿美元存入香港或上海的银行，以备他不得不逃跑时使用，就像他的姻亲宋子文和孙科以及统治南京的所有宋氏家族成员一样，更不用说那些女性了。他行事如独裁者。但我们

TRANSLATION OF EXTRACT FROM EXTREME-ORIENT OF AUGUST, 1939.

Page 25

THE RENT SCANDAL

Will anything be done? Will the S.M.C., which is
full of initiative and gives an astonishing elasticity to
the Land Regulations when it is a question of paying
salaries or pensions of astronomic dimensions to its high
grade employees, break its silence? Will the excellent
Ordinance issued by the late lamented Mr. Wilden putting
a limit to the amount of rent increases and prohibiting
key money, be ever enforced?

This is what everybody in Shanghai is asking
and awaiting a solution.

But there is something more. Certain landlords
have not only increased their rents out of all proportions
to the increased charges but they are demanding the cancellation
of existing leases and will not renew them except on
condition that they are made out in terms of the American
gold dollar.

In the case of foreigners who are not under the
jurisdiction of the Chinese Courts, it is to be feared
that these leases in terms of foreign money are valid.
But in the case of Chinese landlords or foreigners amenable
to the jurisdiction of Chinese law, we are convinced that
the American dollar clause is not only without value but
highly reprehensible.

Is or is not China at war? She is. In that
case, can a Chinese citizen undermine her credit with
impunity and devaluate her money in the midst of a crisis?
Certainly not! And the law which prohibits this sort of
offence between persons amenable to Chinese tribunals is
also applicable to foreigners, such as Russians, Rumanians,
Germans etc. who are amenable to these Courts.

This is what one should know.
page_data.zh:
1939年8月《远东评论》摘录译文。

第25页

租金丑闻

会有所行动吗？工部局（S.M.C.）在向其高级雇员支付天文数字般的薪金或养老金时，总是充满主动性，并对《土地章程》展现出惊人的弹性，那么在此次事件中，它会打破沉默吗？已故的威尔登先生（Mr. Wilden）曾颁布一项优秀的条例，限制租金上涨幅度并禁止收取顶费，该条例究竟能否得到执行？

这是上海每个人都在询问并等待解决的问题。

但还有更严重的问题。某些房东不仅大幅提高了租金，其涨幅与成本增加完全不成比例，而且他们要求取消现有租约，除非新租约以美国金元为计价单位，否则不予续租。

对于不受中国法院管辖的外国人而言，恐怕这些以外币计价的租约是有效的。但对于中国房东或受中国法律管辖的外国人，我们确信，美元条款不仅毫无价值，而且极应受到谴责。

中国是否处于战争状态？是的。既然如此，中国公民岂能在此危机时刻肆意破坏国家信用并使货币贬值而免受惩罚？当然不能！禁止此类行为的法律适用于受中国法庭管辖的人，同样也适用于受这些法庭管辖的外国人，如俄罗斯人、罗马尼亚人、德国人等。

这是人们应当了解的常识。

Page 30
THE CAUSES OF THE ANGLO-JAPANESE CONFLICT
(By Ajax)
Japan's best friends and the most fervent
admirers of her civilization cannot excuse the tactics
she has adopted towards British residents at Tientsin,
Tsingtao and other places. This policy has one fault:
for it alienates the sympathy Japan has enjoyed throughout the
world, even among the immense majority of Germans and
Italians. Whatever may have been the motives, good or
bad, imputed to Japan and whatever may have been the
mistakes committed by British policy in China----and
grave mistakes have not ceased to be laid to the door
of this policy since the Washington Conference---there
are ways to which a people proud of its honour, its
traditional courtesy and its "bushido" famous throughout the
world never abases itself.
We believe, we are even certain, that the Japanese
leaders, amongst whom are to be found men of the greatest
valour, regret in their hearts that their military should
have so far forgotten the elementary rules of fair play
and could have been guilty of such conduct.
Having said this much, let us now try to find
an explanation for this curious violence.
It is not without analogy to what had happened
in Italy on the morrow of the regrettable policy of
sanctions following upon the occupation of Abyssinia.
Britain's policy in this instance was a mistake----
and all impartial historians admit this. Britain has failed
to obtain a single result from the occupation by Italy of
this part of the African continent. Certain historians
hold the view that, originally, Italy's policy was only

1939年8月《远东评论》摘录译文。
第30页
英日冲突的原因
（作者：Ajax）

即便是日本最好的朋友及其文明最热情的仰慕者，也无法为日本在天津、青岛及其他地方对英国居民所采取的战术开脱。这一政策有一个缺陷：它疏远了日本在全世界——甚至在绝大多数德国人和意大利人中间——所享有的同情。无论人们归咎于日本的动机是好是坏，也无论英国对华政策犯了什么错误——自华盛顿会议以来，严重的错误一直被视为该政策的罪责——但有些行为是一个以其荣誉、传统礼仪和闻名世界的“武士道”为荣的民族绝不会自降身份去做的。

我们相信，甚至确信，日本领导人中不乏最具勇气之人，他们在内心深处 regret 其军队竟如此忘记公平竞争的基本规则，并犯下此种行径。

话已至此，让我们试着为这种奇怪的暴力行为寻找一个解释。

这与意大利在占领阿比西尼亚后实施令人遗憾的制裁政策次日所发生的情况不无相似之处。英国在此事上的政策是一个错误——所有公正的历史学家都承认这一点。英国未能从意大利占领非洲大陆这一部分中获得任何成果。某些历史学家认为，最初意大利的政策仅仅是

page_data.en:
-2-
to assure herself of a vast commercial market and outlet in
Abyssinia----perhaps a sort of protectorate----the idea of
a conquest, pure and simple, was thought of and carried
out only as a result of the threats directed at Italy.
It appears that Japan's policy is taking the same
line in China. It is not impossible that if Japan had
not found herself faced with obstructions----obstructions
created not by China only----she might have been satisfied
with extending and maintaining her influence in the region
bordering on the Great Wall but in any case, to the north
of the Yellow River only.
The starting of hostilities in Shanghai by the
Chinese was a colossal blunder for it called forth
Japanese action in regions in which she might not have
desired to make her hand felt in such a formidable manner.
It has been said and written that this "diversion" was
according to the laws of war. I do not think so. It
has also been said and written that China was inspired by
certain foreign advisors who had found feminine ears too
willing to listen to their suggestions. There is no way
of coming to a definite conclusion over this subject.
An observer of Far Eastern affairs said one day
that the quarrel between Japan and Great Britain resembles
very closely a quarrel between two lovers. An abandoned
mistress will recoil at nothing to gratify her rancour; wounded
to the heart, her love changes to hate. There is plenty
of this at the bottom of Japan's feeling against Britain.
This hatred, let us confess impartially, is not without
grave cause.
All impartial historians of events in the Far
East during the past few years deplore the post-war attitude
of Great Britain towards her old and faithful ally, Japan.
page_data.zh:
-2-
确保其在阿比西尼亚拥有广阔的商业市场和出口渠道——或许是一种保护国形式——纯粹简单的征服念头，只是作为对意大利施加威胁的结果才被想到并付诸实施。

看来日本在华政策正采取同样的路线。如果日本没有面临阻碍——这些阻碍并非仅由中国制造——她或许会满足于在长城周边地区，但无论如何仅限于黄河以北地区，扩展并维持其影响力。

中国在上海挑起战端是一个巨大的失策，因为它引来了日本在她可能并不希望以如此可怕的方式展示实力的地区采取行动。有人声称并撰文指出，这种“转移视线”的做法符合战争法则。我不这么认为。也有人声称并撰文指出，中国是受到某些外国顾问的唆使，而这些顾问发现有些女性耳朵太乐意倾听他们的建议。对此问题无法得出确切的结论。

一位远东事务观察家曾说，日本与英国的争吵非常类似于恋人间的争吵。被抛弃的情妇为了发泄怨恨会不择手段；心受重创，爱转化为恨。在日本对英国的情感深处，这类情绪比比皆是。让我们公正地承认，这种仇恨并非没有严重的缘由。

所有公正记录过去几年远东事件的历史学家都对英国战后对其古老而忠实的盟友日本的态度表示惋惜。

page_data.en:
-3-
Let us observe here that it was not the British people who
had acted in this manner.
The bravery of the Japanese army and navy, the
beautiful traditions which they had always observed, the
magnificent enthusiasm of her modern civilization----
all this has not only enchanted novelists like Loti or
Farrere, but also all who held the view that Japan
constituted, in Asia, an advanced sentry against the
dangers of communism.
Since 1911, Great Britain and Japan had signed
a formal treaty of alliance which was to last ten years.
It was determined in 1921. In the meantime the Great War
broke out. Japan not only did her share as an ally in the
Far East but she also offered to send several Divisions
to the front in Europe. It was Lloyd George who had
formally made the suggestion in the name of the Japanese
Government.
Upon the termination of the war, there was a
possibility that Japan would be refused compensation in
any shape or form. Lloyd George, the weather-cock, took
the part of the Chinese against Japan at Versailles, but
through the intervention of President Wilson ( see
"The History of China's International Relations" by
Morse and Mcnair) Tsingtao was not immediately restored to
China. In the capture of Tsingtao, the Japanese lost
1900 killed and wounded, while the Chinese looked on without
moving a little finger. Two years later, Japan was forced
at Washington to give up Tsingtao without any compensation
whatever.
This famous Nine Power Conference was held at
Washington and lasted until the beginning of 1922. To
the Chinese who, during the war, had done nothing beyond
furnishing manual labour for which she was handsomely paid,
page_data.zh:
-3-
在此我们要指出，采取这种行动的并非英国人民。

日本陆军的英勇、他们始终恪守的美好传统、其现代文明的辉煌热情——这一切不仅迷倒了像洛蒂（Loti）或法雷尔（Farrere）这样的小说家，也迷倒了所有认为日本在亚洲构成了抵御共产主义危险的先进哨兵的人们。

自1911年以来，英国与日本签署了一项为期十年的正式同盟条约。该条约于1921年终止。在此期间，大战爆发。日本不仅在远东尽到了盟友的责任，还主动提出派遣数个师前往欧洲前线。是劳合·乔治（Lloyd George）代表日本政府正式提出了这一建议。

战争结束后，日本有可能被拒绝任何形式的赔偿。风向标式的人物劳合·乔治在凡尔赛站在中方一边反对日本，但由于威尔逊总统的干预（参见摩尔斯和麦克奈尔著的《中国国际关系史》），青岛并未立即归还中国。在攻占青岛的战斗中，日军伤亡1900人，而中国人则袖手旁观，未动一指。两年后，日本在华盛顿被迫无偿放弃青岛。

这次著名的九国会议在华盛顿举行，一直持续到1922年初。对于中国在战争期间除了提供有偿劳工外无所作为的表现，

page_data.en:
-4-

everything that they desired was accorded to them: the
giving up by Japan of Tsingtao, the territory of Kiaochao and
the Tsinan Railway; the raising of the Customs duty to,
theoretically, 7; but actually it was raised to astronomic
heights, on condition that China abandons the odious likin
which later became more flourishing; the suppression of the
international Post Offices; consideration of the question of the
abolition of extraterritoriality; the rendition of Weihaiwei
etc., etc.. As for the Japanese they were given the mandate
over a few islands in the Pacific. Moreover, Great Britain
denounced the Anglo-Japanese alliance and declared that
henceforth she would interest herself in China and her
500,000,000 people.

One cannot say how deeply Japan felt, rightly or
wrongly, over this treatment. All that her injured "amour
propre"
felt in the form of rancour began to accumulate in the soul
of the son of the Samurai. Events which followed could
not fail gradually to lead this feeling to a point where
bitterness would fatally take the place of friendship and
brotherhood in arms.

Great Britain did nothing to soothe this sore
with any balm; on the contrary, the uncertainty of defeatism
in the Far East was on the agenda of the Baldwin's, the
Macdonald's, the Henderson's (the Henderson who was
President of the Second Internationale).

When the Shanghai Municipal Police was attacked
on Nanking Road in Shanghai in May, 1925, and the Police
had to defend itself against 3,000 rioters, Commissioner
of Police McEuen was discharged. In 1927, soon after the
arrival of the Communist troops under Chiang Kai-shek and
Gallen alias Blucher, the British hastily abandoned these
concessions in Hankow and in Kiukiang. Even before the
page_data.zh:
-4-

列强满足了她的一切愿望：日本放弃青岛、胶州领土及津浦铁路（注：原文为Tsinan Railway，即济南铁路，通常指胶济铁路或相关路段，此处依原文直译或理解为山东境内铁路权益）；关税税率理论上提高至7%，但实际上提高到了天文数字般的高度，条件是中国废除令人厌恶的厘金制度（该制度后来反而更加猖獗）；撤销国际邮局；考虑废除治外法权的问题；归还威海卫等等。至于日本，仅获得了太平洋上几个岛屿的委任统治权。此外，英国废除了英日同盟，并宣布此后将关注中国及其五亿人民。

人们无法言说日本对这种待遇感受之深，无论其对错。她那受伤的“自尊心”所感受到的怨恨开始在日本武士之子的心灵中积聚。随后发生的事件不可避免地逐渐将这种情绪推向一个临界点，使得苦涩最终取代了友谊和战友之情。

英国并未采取任何措施来抚慰这一创伤；相反，鲍德温（Baldwin）、麦克唐纳（Macdonald）和亨德森（Henderson，即第二国际主席亨德森）等人议程上的远东失败主义不确定性日益加剧。

1925年5月，上海公共租界警务处在南京路遭到袭击，警察不得不防御3000名暴徒，警务处长麦尤恩（McEuen）因此被解职。1927年，在蒋介石和加伦（Gallen，又名布留赫尔/Blucher）率领的共产党军队抵达后不久，英国匆忙放弃了汉口和九江的租界。甚至在这些军队于1927年抵达上海之前，

page_data.en:
-5-
arrival of these troops here in 1927, the British
authorities had induced the International Settlement to
return the Mixed Court to the Chinese under General
Sun Chuan-fan without caring what the Peking Government
would think about its action.
Finally, when the anti-Japanese boycott movement
broke out, a boycott which was certainly inspired by foreign
Communist directors and the Comintern, and when large
numbers of Japanese godowns and Chinese stores selling
Japanese goods were attacked and plundered by organized bands
right in the heart of the International Settlement, it was
evident that a policy of non-intervention was the proper
thing to do.
In 1931, the Manchurian affair troubled the
whole Anglo-Saxon world. It is strange to relate that when
in 1929 Soviet Russia invaded Manchuria, bombarded all the
towns along the railway to a depth of 200 kilometers and
routed the Manchurian troops----nobody said a word. As the
League of Nations had received no warning on that occasion,
the incident ended to the satisfaction of the Soviet and
nothing was said about it. But when the Japanese did the
same thing in Mukden in September, 1931, the Anglo-Saxon
world was furious and the League of Nations exhibited great
activity. One result of all this was that the excited
Chinese were led to put up a resistance, while the Japanese
started a bitter campaign which ended with the conquest of
Manchuria and Jehol. It is possible that if the Mukden
Incident had been treated with the same indifference as that
of Hailar in 1929, Manchuria would to-day still be forming
a part of China's territory!
Then came the great Chinese offensive of July-
August 1937 and this time, Great Britain, as she had taken
page_data.zh:
-5-
英国当局就已促使公共租界将混合法庭交还给孙传芳将军领导下的中方，而不顾北京政府对此举作何感想。

最后，当反日抵制运动爆发时——这场抵制无疑是由外国共产党指挥者和共产国际煽动的——当大批日本仓库和售卖日货的中国商店在公共租界中心地带遭到有组织的团伙攻击和掠夺时，显然，不干涉政策才是适当的应对之道。

1931年，满洲事变震动了整个盎格鲁-撒克逊世界。奇怪的是，1929年苏联入侵满洲，轰炸铁路沿线纵深200公里的所有城镇，并击溃满洲军队时——无人置一词。由于国际联盟当时未收到任何警告，该事件以苏联满意而告终，未引起任何议论。但当日本于1931年9月在沈阳做同样的事情时，盎格鲁-撒克逊世界愤怒了，国际联盟也表现出极大的活跃度。这一切的结果之一是，激动的中国人被引导进行抵抗，而日本人则发起了一场激烈的战役，最终以征服满洲和热河告终。有可能如果沈阳事变像1929年海拉尔事件那样被冷漠对待，满洲今天仍将是中国领土的一部分！

接着是1937年7月至8月中国的大规模进攻，这一次，英国如同此前对意大利采取立场一样，

page_data.en:
-6-
up a stand against Italy, declared her intention to oppose
Japan's operations indirectly. It is not said that in
doing so she was theoretically wrong. But practically she
was wrong. In the case of Italy, British policy has not
prevented anything at all; the only consequence was our
loss of an ally and a companion at arms in the Great War.
With Japan, it was the same. Here also we
have lost an ally who has passed with Italy to the other
side of the barricade. A fine piece of work; but if it
is to be judged according to benefits that we may have
derived therefrom, they amount exactly to zero!
One should not be surprised if a section of
the French Press, as a result of the incidents in Tientsin,
gives an exhibition of ill-humour, no matter how deep is
the friendship between France and Britain.
The world is unanimous in reproaching the
conduct of the Japanese army but the opinion is also held
that the Japanese military was not without reason when it
reproaches Great Britain with prolonging the conflict by
rendering moral and financial assistance to its enemy.
Only the methods it employed were rough.
It is a matter for congratulation if France,
in the thorny circumstances, can maintain her balance of
sanity between two theses that are so dangerously different.

宣布打算间接反对日本的行动。不能说她在理论上做错了。但在实践上她错了。在对意大利的案例中，英国的政策未能阻止任何事情；唯一的后果是我们失去了一位盟友和大战中的战友。对日本也是如此。在这里，我们也失去了一位盟友，他已与意大利一起转到了街垒的另一边。这是一件“杰作”；但如果根据我们从中获得的利益来评判，这些利益恰好为零！

鉴于天津发生的事件，法国新闻界的一部分表现出不良情绪，这不足为奇，无论法英友谊多么深厚。

全世界一致谴责日本军队的行为，但也有观点认为，日本军方指责英国通过向其敌人提供道义和财政援助而延长冲突，并非毫无道理。只是其采用的手段过于粗暴。

值得庆幸的是，法国在这种棘手的情况下，能够在两个如此危险地对立的论点之间保持理智的平衡。

Page 21.

THE HOUSING CRISIS IN SHANGHAI

The housing crisis has become so acute that the authorities of the French Concession and the International Settlement can no longer remain indifferent.
Each time a serious social upheaval occurs, grave problems arise. After the world war, every country adopted strong measures, while in France the relations between land-lord and tenant were still determined by law and handled by the Courts.
In Shanghai the crisis has been particularly aggravated for over a year as a result of events of which the whole world knows, one of which is the influx of Chinese refugees most of whom are to be pitied but quite a few are wealthy people, some of whom are politicians or Generals who left the front and came here with their families and followers and political agitators, etc. Later came the unfortunate Jewish refugees who, after all, are not dogs and have a right to shelter of some kind. They have found accommodation north of the Soochow Creek and it must be acknowledged that the task of the Committees to find a shelter for these unfortunate people was greatly facilitated by the Japanese authorities. The case of the Jewish refugees does not come into the question for their reduced financial standing removes them as a factor from the housing problem.
There then remains the question of the eviction of foreign tenants by certain moneyed people.
At the start, let us deal, once and for all, with the argument that is always being brought up by die-hards. There are certain people who would contradict anything the moment it is put forward. However regrettable it may this tendency exists often among those people who are looking after the welfare of the community.
The Chinese people are in their own country and have the right to stay where and how they please. But when it comes to the question of the Foreign Settlements, however, there is a difference. The territory covered by the Foreign Settlements is "conceded" by China to certain foreign Powers, such as France, Great Britain and America under certain conditions which, if they have been neglected or voluntarily unenforced, are still the basis of the constitution of the Foreign Settlements and are valid at law.
Without delving too deeply into history, it will be sufficient to recall that as a result of the Treaty of Nanking of August 29, 1842 signed by Great Britain, the Treaty of September 24, 1844 signed by France and the Treaty of July 9, 1844 (confirmed in 1848) signed by America, three areas were granted to British, French and American nationals for their exclusive residence, and the residence of their families, servants and employees.
In principle, the Chinese people have no right whatever to reside in these Settlements.
When the Taiping Rebellion broke out, it is regrettable to record that the British Government for the first time backed the wrong side and fought indirectly against the Christian, mystical and modern government of the "Faithful Prince Wang." During the trouble Chinese refugees entered the Settlements and were not driven out. Wealthy Chinese, including merchants, fled into these areas to escape the pillage and massacre which was going on in the neighbouring
