第21页。

上海的住房危机

住房危机已变得如此严峻，以至于法租界和国际租界的当局再也无法对此漠不关心。
每当发生严重的社会动荡时，就会产生严重的问题。世界大战后，各国都采取了强有力的措施，而在法国，房东与房客之间的关系仍由法律决定并由法院处理。
在上海，由于举世皆知的事件，危机在过去一年多里尤为加剧，其中之一便是中国难民的涌入，其中大多数人是值得同情的，但也有不少是富人，有些是离开前线携家眷、随从及政治煽动者等来此的政客或将军。随后到来的是不幸的犹太难民，他们毕竟不是狗，有权获得某种栖身之所。他们在苏州河以北找到了住所，必须承认，日本当局极大地便利了各委员会为这些不幸者寻找庇护所的工作。犹太难民的情况不属于本题讨论范围，因为他们经济状况窘迫，使其不再成为住房问题中的一个因素。
于是剩下的问题便是某些有钱人驱逐外籍租户。
首先，让我们一劳永逸地处理那些顽固分子总是提出的论点。有些人一旦有人提出观点便加以反驳。尽管这种倾向令人遗憾，但它常存在于那些关心社区福祉的人当中。
中国人民在自己的国家，有权随心所欲地居住在任何地方。然而，当涉及外国租界问题时，情况则有所不同。外国租界所涵盖的领土是中国在特定条件下“让予”给法国、英国和美国等外国列强的，这些条件即便被忽视或自愿不予执行，仍然是外国租界构成的基础，且在法律上有效。
无需深入探究历史，只需回顾一下，由于英国于1842年8月29日签署的《南京条约》、法国于1844年9月24日签署的条约以及美国于1844年7月9日签署（1848年确认）的条约，三个区域被授予英国、法国和美国国民及其家属、仆人和雇员独家居住。
原则上，中国人民无权在这些租界内居住。
当太平天国运动爆发时，令人遗憾的是，英国政府首次站错了队，间接对抗了“忠王”那具有基督教色彩、神秘主义且现代化的政府。在动乱期间，中国难民进入租界且未被驱赶。包括商人在内的富裕中国人逃入这些地区，以躲避邻近地区正在发生的掠夺和屠杀

（批注：J.C.B. / J.L.E. / 7月24日。）

page_data.en:
- 2 -

areas. They were allowed to remain. This was the first
stage in the development of Shanghai.
The Foreign Settlements were established for
the exclusive residence of foreigners. There is no question
of eliminating the Chinese population. The point arises as
to whether it is permitted for a certain section of this
Chinese population to drive away from this port those who
created the prosperity of this magnificent area.
As for the bombardment of August, 1937 historians
will one day call it a bloody attempt (partially successful)
to drive away the foreign population of Shanghai with a view
to seizing the Foreign Settlements during the panic.
But what about the eviction, slow but sure, of
a large number of foreigners from their homes so that their
houses may be leased to wealthy refugees? Do you know that
the whole of one residential section in the French Concession
of Shanghai, namely, Rue Massenet, which not so long ago was
exclusively occupied by rich Chinese who made use of the
dollar to drive away the foreign tenants.
It is the landlords or their managers who are
engaged in this shameful practice, who are demanding
exorbitant key money from tenants at the expiry of their
leases or evicting them to make room for the households of
concubines and their abominable brats. During the past two
years these beautiful residences with a few exceptions have
been occupied by Chinese, some of whom have paid as much as
$10,000 for the eviction of the foreign tenants.. The
foreigners now occupy apartments which are less comfortable.
Praise is due to the French Companies and to the
administrators of French property for holding themselves in
hand. Since not a single case of exploitation has taken
place.
On the other hand, certain foreign companies
have not hesitated at veritable extortion directed against
their tenants at the expiry of their leases. Houses are
leased to Chinese who have to pay a huge sum as "security"!
The middlemen, the employees of these firms, the brokers,
the shroffs, etc. profited by this state of affairs and a
shameful mart is at present in full swing.
Practically everybody has seen advertisements
in newspapers offering $3000 to $4000 to secure an apartment
or a house. Out of curiosity, I looked into three of these
offers. In two of these cases, the principals were Russians.
In the third case, the advertiser was an American whose salary
is paid at the rate of Shanghai $8 to $1 U.S. They wanted an
apartment with a reasonable amount of furniture.
This eviction of tenants to the profit of land-
lords or of their representatives, who are more unscrupulous
still, would not have been possible if there had been enforced
in Shanghai laws which are in force practically everywhere,
especially in Hongkong.
One strange aspect is that the Chinese Courts have
kept abreast of this state of affairs by declaring, with
proper reason, that no tenant may be evicted under present
circumstances. However, they went too far in this sense:
that foreign landlords will not be able to evict tenants who
not only refuse to agree to a reasonable increase in rent but
who have refused to pay their rent for a long time.
The foreign Courts have not adopted a uniform
policy, but as a rule they allow tenants every possible delay.
However, if the Municipal authorities of the
Foreign Settlements could come to an understanding, it would
be an easy matter for them to adopt a modus vivendi which, if
it does not place an absolute check upon the practice, would
at least protect tenants from unjust eviction. In this
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

地区。他们被允许留下。这是上海发展的第一阶段。
外国租界是为外国人独家居住而设立的。并非要消除中国人口。问题在于，是否允许这部分中国人口中的某些人将创造这一辉煌地区繁荣的人们从这个港口赶走。
至于1937年8月的轰炸，历史学家总有一天会称其为一次血腥的尝试（部分成功），旨在恐慌中夺取外国租界，从而驱赶上海的外国人口。
但是，为了将房屋出租给富有的难民，大量外国人被缓慢但肯定地从家中驱逐出去，这又是怎么回事呢？你可知道，上海法租界的一个住宅区，即马思南路（Rue Massenet），不久前还完全由富裕的中国人占据，他们利用美元赶走了外籍租户。
从事这种可耻行径的是房东或其管理人，他们在租约到期时向租户索取高额的顶费，或将他们驱逐，以便为妾室及其可恶的孩子腾出空间。在过去两年里，除少数例外，这些漂亮的住宅已被中国人占据，其中一些人为了驱逐外籍租户支付了高达10,000美元的费用。外国人现在居住的公寓舒适度较低。
法国公司及法国物业的管理者因克制自己而值得称赞。因为未发生一起剥削案件。
另一方面，某些外国公司在租约到期时毫不犹豫地对其租户进行真正的勒索。房屋被出租给必须支付巨额“保证金”的中国人！中间人、这些公司的雇员、经纪人、钱庄职员等从这种局面中获利，一个可耻的市场目前正如火如荼地进行着。
几乎每个人都看到过报纸上刊登的广告，出价3000至4000美元以确保获得一套公寓或一所房屋。出于好奇，我调查了其中的三个报价。在其中两个案例中，委托人是俄罗斯人。在第三个案例中，广告发布者是一名美国人，其薪水按上海银元8元兑1美元的汇率支付。他们想要一套配有适量家具的公寓。
如果上海执行了几乎 everywhere（各地），特别是香港通行的法律，这种为了房东或其更无良的代表人的利益而驱逐租户的行为本不可能发生。
一个奇怪的现象是，中国法院通过宣布在当前情况下不得驱逐任何租户，紧跟了这一事态的发展，此举理由充分。然而，他们在此方面走得太远：外国房东将无法驱逐那些不仅拒绝同意合理增加租金，而且长期拒绝支付租金的租户。
外国法院并未采取统一的政策，但通常他们会给予租户尽可能多的宽限期。
然而，如果外国租界的市政当局能够达成共识，他们很容易达成一种临时协定，即使不能绝对制止这种做法，至少也能保护租户免受不公正的驱逐。在这方面

page_data.en:
- 3 -

respect, the hands of the French authorities are freer. The
Consular or Municipal regulations already published contain
sufficient grounds, such as those relating to Classified
Establishments, to enable them to declare that in the French
Concession, key money is prohibited and refund may be demanded
through the Courts. Such is the regulation enforced in
France; such is also the regulation in Hongkong.
It could be laid down that, owing to prevailing
conditions, no tenant may be evicted if he pays his rent or
if he does not oppose a normal increase in rent which must
not be higher than 50% of the cost of the upkeep of the
buildings. Such an increase, in 1937, would have been about
25% to 30% and should not be more.
We believe that some years ago, Mr. Wilden, French
Consul-General in Shanghai, proclaimed an order to this effect.
A similar order at the present time would be welcomed
by all.

Page 35.

INFANTICIDE IN SHANGHAI

An average of 4000 dead bodies of infants are collected
from the streets of the Foreign Settlements every month.
Imagine the figure: 4000 small dead bodies and this
does not take into account the hundreds of adult corpses.
Sometimes these little dead bodies are naked; in most cases
they are covered with some cloth or a piece of matting. All
these bodies are collected by the carts of the Public Health
Departments of the two Foreign Municipalities at daybreak.
If you are curious, take a walk very early one morning
in some area where there is plenty of vacant land near where
some creeks flow, you will find abandoned little corpses
abandoned here and there --- and I would not swear that they
are all absolutely dead. The Chinese Society which specializes
in the removal of these little dead bodies takes them away in
motor trucks. About 4000 bodies are removed in one month or
50,000 in one year.
Is anyone scandalized over this state of affairs? Has
any one cried out in horror? Has anybody endeavoured to locate
the offending parents?
Not a soul, for what would have raised cries of horror
in no matter which civilized country is regarded here as nothing
out of the ordinary. One may read in the Municipal bulletins
that each month thousands of dead bodies are found on the
streets but this information attracts no attention. It is read
and one passes on to the reading of cinema programmes. It is
only in Shanghai that such things can happen.
But Public Prosecution has now suddenly moved. At a
certain part of Keswick Road, a foreigner did what the Chinese
population of Shanghai and of the whole of China has been doing.
But this time it is a serious matter! A poor foreign devil, a
Dane not recognized by his Consulate, a certain Valdemar D....,
one morning found a dead infant on his hands. His wife had
already deserted him and this child was the issue of their
marriage. Of course, he should have followed the proper
procedure but as he was in Shanghai he followed custom. Placing
the body in a bag he took it to a spot on Keswick Road. That
was not nice. He was denounced by "a friend", was arrested and
charged before the First Special District Court where he has
been detained. It is not known what his fate will be.
The Chinese Court and the Police enforced the law, if
there is such a law, against an unfortunate foreigner for doing
something which three or four thousand Chinese parents have
done every month.
Has the finding of two or three hundred dead bodies of
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

面，法国当局的权限更为宽松。已公布的领事或市政规章中包含了足够的依据，例如有关分类场所的规定，使他们能够宣布在法租界禁止收取顶费，并可通过法院要求退还。法国执行的就是这样的规定；香港也是如此。
可以规定，鉴于 prevailing conditions（当前状况），如果租户支付租金，或者不反对正常的租金上涨（涨幅不得超过建筑物维护成本的50%），则不得将其驱逐。这样的涨幅在1937年约为25%至30%，且不应更高。
我们相信，几年前，法国驻上海总领事魏登（Wilden）先生曾颁布过类似命令。
此时若有类似的命令，将受到所有人的欢迎。

第35页。

上海的杀婴现象

每月从外国租界的街道上收集到的婴儿尸体平均为4000具。
想象一下这个数字：4000具小尸体，这还不包括数百具成人尸体。
有时这些小尸体是赤裸的；在大多数情况下，它们被一些布料或一块席子覆盖。所有这些尸体都在黎明时分由两个外国市政机构的公共卫生部门的车辆收集。
如果你好奇，可以在清晨去一些靠近溪流、有大量空地的区域散步，你会发现到处都有被遗弃的小尸体——而且我不敢保证它们全都绝对死亡。专门负责清理这些小尸体的中国社团用卡车将它们运走。一个月运走约4000具尸体，一年则为50,000具。
有人对这种状况感到震惊吗？有人惊恐地呼喊吗？有人试图查明肇事的父母吗？
没有人，因为在任何文明国家都会引起惊恐呼喊的事情，在这里被视为平常事。人们可以在市政公报中读到每月街道上有数千具尸体被发现，但这一信息并未引起注意。人们读过后便转而去阅读电影节目单。这种事只有在上海才会发生。
但是，公诉部门突然采取了行动。在基斯威克路（Keswick Road）的某处，一名外国人做了上海乃至全中国中国人口一直在做的事。但这次事情严重了！一个可怜的外国魔鬼，一个未被其领事馆承认的丹麦人，名叫瓦尔德马·D....（Valdemar D....），一天早上发现手头有一具婴儿尸体。他的妻子已经抛弃了他，这个孩子是他们婚姻的产物。当然，他本应遵循正当程序，但由于他在上海，他便依循习俗。他将尸体装入袋中，带到基斯威克路的一处地点。这并不光彩。他被一名“朋友”告发，被捕并在第一特区法院受审，目前已被拘留。他的命运尚不可知。
中国法院和警察对一名不幸的外国人执行了法律（如果存在这样的法律），只因他做了一件每月有三四千名中国父母都在做的事情。
每天在上海街道上发现两三百具婴儿尸体，是否曾

page_data.en:
- 4 -
infants every day on the streets of Shanghai ever been
made the subject of an investigation? Have the parents
of these children ever been charged?
Who can give us a reply.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -
成为调查的主题？这些孩子的父母是否曾被起诉？
谁能给我们一个答复。

page_data.en:
Page 31

THE SCANDAL OF THE APARTMENTS "TRUST"

Some days ago, a letter on the scandal of the
apartments "Trust" appeared in the "Journal de Shanghai."

The extraordinary apathy of the heterogeneous
population of Shanghai has permitted the Apartments "Trust"
to develop with impunity. Everybody knows how impossible
it is to find an apartment or a house to-day without
encountering cunning speculators or sharpers. In every
country the law prohibits such practices and prosecutes them
in Court.

On the other hand, it is clear that in the face
of the exceptional circumstances through which we are
passing in Shanghai very special measures should be taken.
It is intolerable that there should be different judicial
views, in favour of or to the prejudice of a case according
to the nationality of the parties concerned.

It is fantastic to find, for example, that a
Chinese or Russian tenant (or any one amenable to Chinese
law) can rest forever in his lodgings even if he does not
pay the rent or even if he refuses to agree to a reasonable
increase in rent, while a French citizens will find himself
threatened with eviction by his nation's Court.

This is one of the new cases of "unequal treatment"
about which Chinese propagandists have deafened our ears.
One had hoped that this grave question of apartments or
lodgings monopolized by shameless speculators would have
been developed by the Journal de Shanghai and a solution
be put forward. Unfortunately it did nothing of the kind.

The following letter was sent to the Journal
but was not deemed worthy of publication, despite the
capital information it contained:-
page_data.zh:
第31页

公寓“托拉斯”丑闻

数日前，《上海日报》（Journal de Shanghai）刊登了一封关于公寓“托拉斯”丑闻的来信。

上海混杂人口的异常冷漠，使得公寓“托拉斯”得以肆无忌惮地发展。众所周知，如今若不遇到狡猾的投机商或骗子，要想找到一套公寓或一所房子是不可能的。在任何国家，法律都禁止此类行为并在法庭上予以起诉。

另一方面，显然鉴于我们在上海所经历的非常局势，应采取特别措施。令人无法容忍的是，根据当事方的国籍不同，司法观点也各异，从而出现有利于或不利于某一案件的情况。

例如，发现一名中国或俄国租户（或任何受中国法律管辖的人），即使不付租金，甚至拒绝同意合理增加租金，仍可永远安居其寓所，而法国公民则会发现自己受到其本国法院驱逐的威胁，这简直是荒谬绝伦。

这是中国宣传家们在我们耳边聒噪不休的“不平等待遇”的新案例之一。人们曾希望，《上海日报》会深入探讨这一由无耻投机商垄断公寓或住房的严重问题，并提出解决方案。不幸的是，该报并未这样做。

以下信件已寄给该报，但尽管其中包含重要信息，却被认为不值得发表：—

page_data.en:
- 2 -

THE APARTMENTS "TRUST"

To the Editor,

The ordinance of December 31, 1937, is not the
one which your correspondent should have invoked. It
is not without interest but it is far from being complete
as it has given rise to an incorrect interpretation. The
Courts had to follow this administrative interpretation
because it was unaware that there exists another text,
infinitely more important, and which always has the force
of law in the French Concession: this is the Consular
Ordinance on rentals signed by Mr. Wilden on November 2,
1921.

Let me recall that a Consular Ordinance has the
force of law so long as it has not been repealed by another
Ordinance. An investigation has revealed that this
Ordinance has never been repealed and that it is still in
force.

The full text of the Ordinance in question follows:-

Ordinance

We, Consul-General for France at Shanghai, Chevalier
of the Legion of Honour,

In consideration of the regulations of the Municipal
organization of the French Concession of April 14, 1866,

In consideration of Article XIII,

In view of the housing crisis which should be
ameliorated as much as possible,

In view of the fact that it concerns a question
of peace and order,

For this reason, we have ordered and order:-

Article 1.--Any person who for purposes of unlawful
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

公寓“托拉斯”

致编辑先生：

1937年12月31日的法令并非贵报通讯员所应援引的法令。该法令并非毫无意义，但远非完整，因为它引起了错误的解释。法院不得不遵循这一行政解释，因为它们不知道还存在另一项文本，其重要性无限更大，且在法租界始终具有法律效力：这就是1921年11月2日由威尔登（Wilden）先生签署的领事租金法令。

让我重申，领事法令只要未被另一项法令废除，即具有法律效力。调查显示，该法令从未被废除，且仍然有效。

有关法令全文如下：—

法令

我们，驻上海法国总领事，荣誉军团骑士，

考虑到1866年4月14日法租界市政组织章程，

考虑到第十三条，

鉴于住房危机应尽可能得到缓解，

鉴于这涉及治安与秩序问题，

为此，我们命令并规定：—

第一条.—任何人为非法

page_data.en:
- 3 -

speculation secures a monopoly of lodgings may be
prosecuted with a view to securing the cancellation of
all unlawfully executed leases and the payment of damages.

Article 2.--Rentals that are higher than the
rates of interest representing a normal increase in the
charges for the built-up property and ordinary and free
trade competition will not be upheld at law.

Article 3.--Any increase in rentals under the
conditions mentioned in Article 2 may be reclaimed by the
tenant.

Article 4-- All sums of money known as "Key
Money" cannot be reclaimed at law.

Article 5.--Cannot also be reclaimed at law
sums of money paid in the form of "Key Money."

Article 6.--The refunding of sums of money
paid as "Key Money" may be ordered by the Court.

Article 7.--The monopolizing of lodgings and
the demanding of "Key Money" render the parties concerned
liable, besides cancellation if they are Chinese or such
like, to a fine, according to the importance of the amounts
unlawfully demanded, of one-third of the rent or one-third
of the "Key Money", without prejudice to the application,
if there be any, of penalties under Article 382 of the
Chinese Penal Code.

Article 8.--The present Ordinance comes into
force as from this date.

Done and given at Shanghai at the Consulate, this
Second Day of November, one thousand nine hundred and
twenty-one.

(Signed) Wilden.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

投机目的而垄断住房者，可被起诉，以期取消所有非法签订的租约并支付损害赔偿金。

第二条.—高于代表建成物业费用正常增长及普通自由贸易竞争的利率水平的租金，在法律上将不予支持。

第三条.—在第二条所述条件下增加的租金，租户可要求退还。

第四条.—所有被称为“顶费”（Key Money）的款项，在法律上不可追回。

第五条.—以“顶费”形式支付的款项，在法律上亦不可追回。

第六条.—法院可命令退还作为“顶费”支付的款项。

第七条.—垄断住房及索要“顶费”的行为，除导致租约取消外（若当事人为中国人或类似身份者），还使有关各方 liable（有责任）缴纳罚款，根据非法索要金额的重要性，罚款数额为租金的三分之一或“顶费”的三分之一，且不影响适用《中国刑法典》第382条规定的刑罚（如有）。

第八条.—本法令自即日起生效。

于一千九百二十一年十一月二日在上海领事馆签署并发布。

（签名）威尔登（Wilden）。

page_data.en:
- 4 -

Thus, in the French Concession at the present time
this Ordinance has the same force as a law like all the
other laws which the Second Special District Court enforces.
It should not be imagined, therefore, that because the Mixed
Court has passed away this Ordinance cannot be applied any
more. One has but to awake it from its sleep, while the
Municipal Advocate should draw the attention of the Second
Special District Court to the necessity of putting it into
force each time that a well established complaint arises.

As for the foreigners within the orbit of the
"combine" and who enjoy extraterritoriality, it is little
likely that the foreign Courts will place obstructions on
the enforcement of a measure designed to thwart such an
intolerable state of affairs.

In his letter your correspondent quoted passages
of an interpretation of the Ordinance of December, 1937.
This interpretation completely failed to take into account
the Ordinance of November 2, 1921. Furthermore, in arguing
a fortiori that the most exorbitant extortions in the matter
of rentals did not obstruct the law of supply and demand,
they are committing hara-kiri, they are placing the rope
around their neck! For what could be greater obstruction
to the law of supply and demand in the matter of rentals
than the demand for key money or other fantastic demands.
The free market disappears the moment this system, which
is penalised in every part of the world, is authorized.!

On the other hand, owing to prevailing conditions
and the state of war, every tenant who is paying his rent
regularly and has agreed to an increase justified by the
cost of living must be rendered safe from eviction, whether
he has a lease or not. The idea, although paradoxical,
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

因此，目前在法租界，该法令与第二特区法院执行的所有其他法律一样，具有同等的法律效力。因此，不应认为因为混合法庭已成为历史，该法令便不再适用。只需将其从沉睡中唤醒，而市公诉人应在每次出现确凿投诉时，提请第二特区法院注意执行该法令的必要性。

至于处于该“联合体”势力范围内并享有治外法权的外国人，外国法院不太可能阻碍执行旨在挫败这种不可容忍局势的措施。

贵报通讯员在信中引用了对1937年12月法令解释的段落。该解释完全未考虑1921年11月2日的法令。此外，他们在论证中强词夺理，声称租金方面最过分的勒索并不妨碍供需法则，这无异于自杀，是自套绳索！因为，还有什么比索要顶费或其他荒谬要求更严重地妨碍租金方面的供需法则呢？一旦这种在世界各地均受惩罚的制度被允许，自由市场即刻消失！

另一方面，由于 prevailing conditions（现行状况）和战争状态，每一位定期支付租金并同意因生活成本上涨而合理增加租金的租户，无论其是否有租约，都必须免受驱逐。这一想法虽然看似矛盾，

page_data.en:
- 5 -

which is at the base of recent decisions in the Chinese
Courts is worth its weight in gold. Every tenant, according
to this fantastic jurisprudence, who is on the month-to-month
basis may remain indefinitely, but he who has signed a
lease in order to avoid the risk of being evicted with
one month's notice may find himself evicted at the expiry
of his lease.

Conclusions.

1) If in 1921 the French authorities in Shanghai
considered the then housing crisis such as to call for
ameliorative measures, how much more is to be said for the
housing crisis in 1939.

2) The Consular Ordinance of November 2, 1921 is still
in force although it may now be lying forgotten in some
Municipal drawer. We . with the immense majority of residents
of the French Concession, express the hope that this law
will quickly be enforced.

3) This Ordinance was inspired by a praise-worthy
interest in the entire body of ratepayers and was passed at
the initiative of the late Mr. Wilden. This law should be
applied in the same spirit as similar other laws are being
applied in France and especially in Hongkong since the
commencement of hostilities. No tenant, irrespective
of the fact as to whether he has or has not a lease, may
be evicted so long as he is a bona fide tenant paying his
rent and agreeing to a normal increase in rent. Such
questions will be left to the Courts for decision and in
the case of Chinese or such people the French Court will be
the competent tribunal.

C. Q. F. D.
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

但作为中国法院近期判决的基础，其价值千金。根据这种荒谬的法理学，每一位按月租赁的租户可以无限期居住，但那些为了避免收到一个月通知即被驱逐的风险而签署租约的人，却可能在租约期满时被驱逐。

结论。

1) 如果1921年上海法国当局认为当时的住房危机需要采取改善措施，那么对于1939年的住房危机，更有何言？

2) 1921年11月2日的领事法令仍然有效，尽管它现在可能被遗忘在某个市政局的抽屉里。我们与法租界绝大多数居民一起，希望该法律能迅速得到执行。

3) 该法令的制定源于对全体纳税人整体利益的值得称赞的关注，并由已故的威尔登（Wilden）先生倡议通过。应以与法国以及特别是自敌对行动开始以来香港应用类似法律相同的精神来应用该法律。只要租户是善意租户，支付租金并同意正常增加租金，无论其是否有租约，均不得被驱逐。此类问题将留待法院裁决，若当事人为中国人或类似身份者，法国法院将为有管辖权的法庭。

C. Q. F. D.（证讫）

EXTRACTS FROM "EXTREME-ORIENT" OF JUNE, 1939.
Page 16

A COMMON SNAKE

One of the common snakes to which we made
allusion in one of our recent numbers has taken upon
itself to make an attack upon us in that inimitable
style which would have made a trooper's son blush
though it is his speciality.

At the first time, we simply shrugged our
shoulders.

But he renewed the attack, egged on probably
by certain personages whose identity is known to me
and who feel that the cap fits their head.

Patience has its limits. This individual
shall make his explanation before a Judge.
page_data.zh:
摘自1939年6月《远东》（EXTREME-ORIENT）。
第16页

一条常见的蛇

我们在最近一期中提到的一条常见的蛇，以其那种虽是其专长、却会让骑兵之子脸红的独特风格，对我们发起了攻击。

起初，我们只是耸了耸肩。

但他再次发起攻击，可能是受到某些人物的怂恿，这些人的身份我已知晓，且觉得这帽子正扣在他们头上。

忍耐是有限度的。此人将在法官面前作出解释。

Extracts from "Extreme-Orient" of June, 1939.

Page 14 (French Section)

MUNICIPAL AFFAIRS
(By "Athena")

There are thousands of residents in the Foreign
Settlements of Shanghai, Chinese and foreign, who never keep
themselves in touch with Municipal affairs which concern them
closely not only from the viewpoint of their welfare but of
their safety as well. We are thinking not only of those who
make themselves scarce as the time for the ratepayers meeting
approaches and who find that everything is in order, but of
that large population which regards Shanghai as its permanent
domicile. It is true that conditions existing since August,
1937, have become more difficult as much for the two Foreign
Settlements as for the public, but the month of August, 1937,
is already far away and since then many problems have arisen
to which the Municipalities could have given their attention.

One of the essential questions to which "Extreme-
Orient" has already devoted several articles, and in respect
of which nothing has been done, is the maintenance of good
order among the huge population thanks to the Police department.

The S.M.C. is satisfied with raising enormously the
already high salaries of a privileged few. In the meantime,
crime has become menacing, acts of terrorism more frequent and
traffic conditions are abominable.

The increase in crime and acts of terrorism, we are
told, is inevitable because of the Sino-Japanese hostilities.
If offenders against common law are caught in the Police nets
most of the time, it is not so in the case of the terrorists.
The reason for this state of affairs is not due to negligence
on the part of the Police whose courage and devotion cannot
be too highly praised. The cause, as we have never ceased
page_data.zh:
摘自1939年6月《远东》。
----------------------------------------------
第14页（法文版）

市政事务
（作者：“雅典娜”）

在上海的外国居留地，有成千上万的中国和外国居民，他们从不关注与其密切相关的市政事务，这不仅关乎他们的福利，也关乎他们的安全。我们想到的不仅是那些在纳税人会议临近时躲得无影无踪、认为一切井然有序的人，还包括那些将上海视为永久住所的大量人口。诚然，自1937年8月以来存在的局势对两个外国居留地和公众而言都变得更加困难，但1937年8月已远去，此后出现了许多本应引起市政当局关注的问题。

《远东》已为此撰写了数篇文章但未获解决的一个基本问题，是依靠警务部门维持庞大人口的良好秩序。

工部局满足于大幅提高少数特权阶层原本已很高的薪水。与此同时，犯罪变得具有威胁性，恐怖活动更加频繁，交通状况糟糕透顶。

有人告诉我们，犯罪和恐怖活动的增加是由于中日敌对行动而不可避免的。如果违犯普通法的罪犯大多时候落入警方罗网，恐怖分子则不然。造成这种局面的原因并非警方的疏忽，警方的勇气和奉献精神值得高度赞扬。其原因，正如我们从未停止

page_data.en:
- 2 -

is due to
to repeat, the insufficient personnel and in the organization
which could be improved.

The S.M.C., as we have said, has made remarkable
efforts to increase, without any necessity whatever, the
salaries of the Heads of Departments, but it has done nothing
to assure public safety in a more efficient manner. In
another part of this issue, the reader will learn what might
have been done with the $720,000 so generously granted under
circumstances which had given rise to general criticism.

As we are on the subject of the personnel of the
Shanghai Municipal Police, let us state here that it is not
true that persons joining the service are paid miserably. In
fact, the lowest salary is $175 per mensem, plus lodging,
medical attendance and other benefits. When one remembers
that most of the recruits for the Police Force come from the
Army or the unemployed in England, the starting pay is adequate.
If, on the other hand, it is claimed that it is difficult to
find men in England, there should be no difficulty in
recruiting men locally. In fact, there are hundreds of
young men, some born in Shanghai, some of whom are Russians,
refugees of various nationalities who would be happy to earn
a living by joining the Police Force. It is claimed that
the S.M.C. holds the view that only British people make good
policemen. It would be difficult to utter a more complete
absurdity!

Has the S.M.C. ever attempted to employ such men?
Yes, a certain number of White Russians --- and what has
happened? The Russian officers have shown themselves as
efficient as their English colleagues. Thus, the somewhat
time-worn excuse that the Russian officers are not as good
as the others is only a joke in poor taste.

The present situation demands urgent measures and
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

重复的那样，在于人员不足以及组织有待改进。

正如我们所说，工部局做出了显著努力，在毫无必要的情况下增加了各部门主管的薪水，但在以更高效的方式确保公共安全方面却无所作为。在本期的另一部分，读者将了解到，那笔在引发普遍批评的情况下慷慨拨付的72万美元本可以用来做什么。

既然谈到上海公共租界警务处的人员问题，我们要在此指出，加入该部门的人员薪水微薄并非事实。事实上，最低薪水为每月175元，外加住宿、医疗和其他福利。当人们想到警察部队的大多数新兵来自军队或英国的失业者时，起薪是足够的。另一方面，如果声称在英国难以找到人手，那么在当地招募人员应该没有困难。事实上，有数百名年轻人，有些出生在上海，有些是俄国人，还有各种国籍的难民，他们很乐意通过加入警察部队来谋生。据称，工部局认为只有英国人才能成为好警察。很难说出比这更完全的荒谬之论了！

工部局是否曾尝试雇用这样的人？是的，有一定数量的白俄人——结果如何？俄国警官证明他们与英国同事一样高效。因此，那种略显陈旧的借口，即俄国警官不如其他人，只是一个品味低劣的笑话。

目前的局势需要紧急措施，并且

page_data.en:
- 3 -

if the S.M.C. persists in following its old and traditional
policy the Council will find itself hurtling down a precipice.

The Control of Traffic

The control of public roads such as it exists in
civilized countries simply does not exist in Shanghai. It
is a reign of disorder. From morning to night one may see
an immense crowd of pedestrians, almost all Chinese, walking
along the roadway as if they were at home; wheel-barrows
and ricshas rushing towards the street crossings in an
endeavour to elude the red light; overladen motor trucks
being driven at high speed; while unfortunate drivers of
motor cars try to clear a path in the midst of this bear
garden which is a subject of laughter and derision to all
foreigners arriving in Shanghai.

One feels that there is no initiative, no general
direction of traffic and that this state of affairs is
becoming worse and worse. Pitiful endeavours were made
on Nanking Road and the result was lamentable. The other
day, at the corner of Nanking and Chekiang Roads, a European
Sergeant endeavoured to make the Chinese understand that
they should wait for the green light to be turned on before
crossing the street. His efforts provided a highly
enjoyable entertainment to the large number of idlers and
loafers who encumbered the streets and soon the unfortunate
officer was surrounded by these people. When the officer
attempted to prevent a suicide candidate from being run
over by vehicles, a dozen others would rush forward to do
likewise just for the pleasure of annoying the officer.

The source of the evil is to be found in the
system itself. As in a large number of cities in foreign
countries, Police officers should be authorized to impose
a fine on the spot on offending pedestrians. When the
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

如果工部局（S.M.C.）坚持其陈旧且传统的政策，董事会将发现自己正冲向悬崖边缘。

交通管理

在文明国家中存在的公共道路管控，在上海根本不存在。这里是一片混乱的统治。从早到晚，人们可以看到大量行人，几乎全是华人，走在车行道上，仿佛是在自己家里一样；独轮车和人力车为了躲避红灯而冲向十字路口；超载的卡车高速行驶；而不幸的汽车司机则试图在这个如同熊园般的混乱中开辟一条道路，这成为所有抵达上海的外国人嘲笑和讥讽的对象。

人们感到缺乏主动性，缺乏对交通的总体指挥，而且这种状况正变得越来越糟。在南京路曾做过一些可怜的努力，结果却令人遗憾。前几天，在南京路与浙江路的拐角处，一名洋人巡佐试图让华人明白，他们应该等待绿灯亮起后再过马路。他的努力给那些充斥街道的大量闲散人员提供了极具娱乐性的消遣，很快，这位不幸的警官就被这些人包围了。当该警官试图阻止一名企图自杀者被车辆碾压时，又有十几个人冲上前去如法炮制，仅仅是为了取乐并惹恼这位警官。

弊病的根源在于制度本身。正如在许多外国城市一样，应授权警务人员对违规行人当场处以罚款。当

page_data.en:
- 4 -

Shanghai pedestrians find that they have to pay 20 cents
they will quickly come to the scratch. But this will require
more staff. The Foreign Settlements in Shanghai possess
only one-third of the number required yet a sum of $720,000
can be distributed among a privileged few. After this one
need be surprised at nothing.

What is one to say of the stupid practice of
permitting motor buses and the thousands of rickshas and
wheel-barrows to move in both directions along Szechuen
Road and Kiangse Road when in even the most backward countries
such roads would long ago have been made into one way traffic.

Finally, the way certain essential roads are
being maintained is simply scandalous. The whole section
of Avenue Edward VII on the International Settlement side
is dirty. It is a haunt of prostitutes, of thousands of
miserable wretches covered with sores and vermin. It is
not uncommon to find corpses here and there at the noon hour
(as such as we recently photographed) or to find these bodies
being encoffined in the midst of general indifference. At
one noon hour, we saw several corpses of infants wrapped in
straw matting.

If we are accused of exaggerating, then we ask
our readers to stop when they are travelling along Avenue
Edward VII and take a look behind the latrines and the motor
trucks parked in the middle of the road on the International
Settlement side. They will be edified.

Public Sanitation

Take a look at the centre of the city and in the
business quarter; equally filthy sights. An average of
50,000 dead bodies are removed from the streets of the two
Settlements every year. The population which encumber the
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

上海的行人发现他们必须支付20分时，他们很快就会守规矩。但这需要更多的人员。上海的外国租界所拥有的警力仅有所需人数的三分之一，然而一笔72万元的款项却可以分配给少数特权阶层。在此之后，人们对任何事都不必感到惊讶。

对于允许公共汽车以及成千上万的人力车和独轮车在四川路和江西路上双向行驶这种愚蠢的做法，人们还能说什么呢？即使是在最落后的国家，这样的道路也早已实行单向交通了。

最后，某些重要道路的维护方式简直令人震惊。国际租界一侧的爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII）整段都很肮脏。这里是妓女、成千上万浑身疮痍和虱子的可怜虫的聚集地。在中午时分，在这里随处可见尸体（例如我们最近拍摄到的那样），或者看到这些尸体在普遍的冷漠中被装殓，这已不足为奇。在一个中午，我们看到几具婴儿的尸体被草席包裹着。

如果我们被指责夸大其词，那么我们请读者在沿着爱德华七世大道行驶时停下来，看看国际租界一侧厕所后面以及停在路中间的卡车后面。他们会受到教益。

公共卫生

看看市中心和商业区；同样是肮脏的景象。每年从两个租界的街道上移走的尸体平均达5万具。充斥

page_data.en:
- 5 -

streets cover the ground with spittle and urinate at every
corner. It is indeed a miracle that epidemics have not
been more frequent and Death has not made Shanghai one of
its favourite haunts.

As regards hospitals, this city of 5,000,000
inhabitants, the fifth largest port in the world, is no
better equipped than a tenth grade city in a foreign
country. Wealthy people have two or three hospitals
at their disposal. As for others, they have either to
die at home or on the street.

Conclusion

It is not at all pleasant for us to indicate
the sores to which the public appear to be so indifferent
but in the face of the apathy of the foreign ratepayers,
in the face of the indifference exhibited by the "city
fathers" and the stupid attitude of the persons who
were present at the last meeting of ratepayers in the
International Settlement, it is impossible not to manifest
some measure of indignation.
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

街道的人群随地吐痰，并在每个角落小便。流行病没有更频繁地爆发，死神没有将上海作为其最喜欢的巢穴之一，这确实是个奇迹。

至于医院，这座拥有500万人口、世界第五大港口的城市，其设备并不比外国的一个十流城市好多少。富人有两三家医院可供使用。至于其他人，他们要么死在家里，要么死在街上。

结论

指出公众似乎如此漠不关心的弊病，对我们来说绝非愉快之事，但面对外国纳税人的冷漠，面对“城市父老”所表现出的漠不关心，以及在国际租界最后一次纳税人会议上出席者的愚蠢态度，不可能不表现出一定程度的愤慨。

TRANSLATION FROM FRENCH OF
EXTRACTS FROM "EXTREME ORIENT" OF FEBRUARY, 1939.

Page 18
TRAFFIC CONDITIONS IN SHANGHAI
(By "Viator")

The newspapers have on many occasions risen against the abominable fashion in which the traffic problem has, or rather has not been, solved in Shanghai. How much longer is this scandal to last? For how much longer are the residents of Shanghai going to tolerate such a state of affairs which would hardly be tolerated among savages and where neglect borders on imbecility?

The Police of the International Settlement and of the French Concession have been praised for their work of preventing and suppressing crime. The Chiefs of the two Police Departments carry out their duties conscientiously and they have a large number of Chinese detectives to help them. They are well served for the Chinese detectives love their work.

On the other hand; the Police Section which is responsible for the supervision of public roads and for the control of traffic are so inefficient and are so inadequately staffed with Chinese policemen that there is no alternative but to laugh or to be indignant.

It is absolutely useless and it is a grotesque excuse to plead that the streets of Shanghai had been planned in a manner as narrow as the spirit of the ancient administrators. The situation to-day is such that it is being generally deplored. In Europe are to be found hundred of towns dating from the Middle Ages, as Rouen, for instance. The streets of these towns are still more tortuous and more congested than those of Shanghai, yet the traffic is well regulated and does not give rise to bottling up or shocking confusion as is the case in Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
1939年2月《远东》杂志摘录的法文译文。

第18页
上海的交通状况
（作者：“Viator”）

报纸曾多次抨击上海解决——或者说未能解决——交通问题的可恶方式。这种丑闻还要持续多久？上海居民还要容忍这种甚至在野蛮人中都难以容忍、疏忽近乎愚笨的状况多久？

公共租界和法租界的警务处在预防和打击犯罪方面的工作受到了赞扬。两个警察部门的主管恪尽职守，并有大量华籍侦探协助他们。华籍侦探热爱自己的工作，因此他们得到了良好的服务。

另一方面；负责监督公共道路和控制交通的警务部门效率极低，且配备的华籍巡捕人数严重不足，以至于人们除了嘲笑或愤怒之外别无选择。

声称上海的街道规划得像古代管理者的思想一样狭窄，这绝对是无用的，也是一个荒谬的借口。如今的局势普遍令人惋惜。在欧洲可以找到数百个源自中世纪的城镇，例如鲁昂（Rouen）。这些城镇的街道比上海的更加曲折和拥堵，但交通管理良好，不会像上海那样造成堵塞或令人震惊的混乱。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

It is very easy to indicate the causes and the
remedies of such a state of affairs and if the person reading
these lines were to be entrusted with the problem of finding
a solution of traffic conditions in Shanghai or, in any case,
to ameliorate the conditions to a considerable extent, he
could change the situation to general satisfaction in 15 days.
    In the first, here are the causes of this state of
affairs :-
    (1) All traffic along the streets in the centre of
the city has to slow down not because of the narrowness of
the streets but because during the principal hours of the
day when traffic is exceedingly heavy all kinds of vehicles
are allowed to use these roads, such as carts, waggons laden
with heavy cases, wheel-barrows and the Lord knows what other
means of transportation belong to the era of Mathusalem. All
these vehicles block the passage of the only normal vehicles
which should be allowed on these roads, namely, motor trucks
and motor cars.
    If an intelligent service would prohibit all these
pre-historic vehicles from the use of the roads in the central
districts of the International Settlement and of the French
Concession between 8 a.m. and 6 p.m. the traffic problem
would already be partly solved. That section of the
International Settlement Bund and the French Bund close to
the river bank could be reserved for these vehicles.
    I ask readers of these lines whether they have
anything to say to this, but I fear they will have forgotten
about the matter within twenty minutes after reading these
lines such is the habitual apathy of Shanghai-landers; they
deserve all the calamities that have befallen them.
    As a matter of fact, there can be no reply to our
suggestion, for the prohibition of slow-moving vehicles on
the great highways is a regulation to be found in all civilized
countries, unless, of course, one does not care for such ideas.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

指出这种状况的原因和补救措施非常容易，如果阅读这些文字的人被委托寻找解决上海交通状况的方案，或者至少在一定程度上改善状况，他可以在15天内改变局面，令各方满意。
    首先，以下是造成这种状况的原因：
    (1) 市中心所有街道的交通不得不减速，并非因为街道狭窄，而是因为在白天交通极其繁忙的主要时段，各种车辆都被允许使用这些道路，如马车、装载重箱的大车、独轮车，天知道还有哪些属于玛土撒拉（Mathusalem，圣经长寿人物，喻指古老时代）时代的交通工具。所有这些车辆阻碍了唯一应被允许在这些道路上通行的正常车辆，即卡车和汽车的通行。
    如果一个明智的管理部门禁止所有这些史前车辆在上午8点至下午6点之间使用公共租界和法租界中心区域的道路，交通问题就已经部分解决了。国际租界外滩和靠近河岸的法租界外滩的那一段可以预留给这些车辆使用。
    我问阅读这些文字的读者对此有何看法，但我担心他们在读完这些文字后二十分钟内就会忘记此事，这就是上海人的习惯性冷漠；他们理应遭受降临到他们头上的所有灾难。
    事实上，对我们的建议无法做出回应，因为在主要干道上禁止慢速车辆行驶是所有文明国家都有的规定，除非当然有人不在乎这些理念。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

In that case, the International Settlement has been rather .
brazen-faced to have styled itself a "Model Settlement."
The hongs operating hand-carts, wheel-barrows
and coolies for the transportation, at snail's pace, of heavy
cases along Szechuen Road or Rue Montauban, for instance, at
11 o'clock in the morning, could transport these cases before
8 o'clock in the morning or after 6 o'clock in the evening or
to transport them in motor trucks.
To this state of affairs, I repeat, one can
only reply with arguments that can only be false or hypocritical.
(2) The Chinese staff undertaking the control of
traffic is (a) inadequate in number, and (b) lamentable in
quality.
I have already indicated, in the correspondence
columns of the "North China Daily News," that the number of
policemen assigned to traffic duty in cities where the people
are well disciplined and where there are no 20,000 ricshas, is
four or five times more than the number in Shanghai; that in
Shanghai, the policemen make only a semblance of supervising
the traffic.
At one time I published the number of so-called
"traffic" policemen in the principal cities of Europe and in
New York. These figures were furnished me by the Prefecture
of Police in Paris. I have also given the exact number of
Chinese and foreign policemen employed by the Police in
Shanghai on traffic duty.
The figures showed 1 to 4 or even 5. In other
words, for one Chinese, Annamite or Sikh policeman who, with
vacant eyes, thinking of his beautiful girl friend or his
plate of noodles or usury according to his feeling and who
hardly makes a movement, there are in a foreign country 4
or 5 energetic policemen who understand their work and with
whom one can not joke.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

在这种情况下，公共租界自称“模范租界”就相当厚颜无耻了。
    例如，在上午11点，那些在四川路或蒙托邦路（Rue Montauban）上用手推车、独轮车和苦力以蜗牛般的速度运输重箱的商号，完全可以在早上8点之前或晚上6点之后运输这些箱子，或者使用卡车运输。
    对于这种状况，我重申，只能用以虚假或虚伪的论点来回应。
    (2) 从事交通管理的华籍员工队伍 (a) 数量不足，且 (b) 质量堪忧。
    我已在《字林西报》（North China Daily News）的通信专栏中指出，在民众纪律严明且没有2万辆人力车的城市里，分配给交通执勤的警察人数是上海的四到五倍；在上海，警察只是装模作样地监管交通。
    我曾公布过欧洲主要城市和纽约所谓的“交通”警察人数。这些数字由巴黎警察局提供给我。我也给出了上海警务处用于交通执勤的华籍和外籍警察的确切人数。
    数据显示比例为1比4甚至5。换句话说，对于一个眼神空洞、想着漂亮女友、一碗面条或高利贷（视其心情而定）、几乎不动弹的华籍、安南籍或锡克籍警察而言，在外国有4或5名精力充沛、懂业务且不容开玩笑的警察。

(Note: This proportion has become infinitely
greater since the hostilities for the number of policemen
has not been increased although the Chinese population
has passed the million and half mark to 3 million! One
can therefore say that at the present time, for one
policeman entrusted with traffic duty in Shanghai there
are 10 policemen in a foreign country. Are you surprised

Page 20

THE "PIVOT BOYS"

The affair of the "pivot boys" of the Inter-
national Settlement is not only an indication of an extremely
regrettable state of affairs, it has amusing side issues too.
When the ratepayers are told that they will
have to pay these people from $5,000 to $7,000 a month, not
counting the additional privileges, such as free passage and
medical service, superannuation, etc., etc., one would be
struck with stupefaction at the possibility of such salaries
being paid not only because of the difficult times we are
passing through but also and above all because the work of
these gentlemen, no matter how delicate it may be, does not
call for more than average intelligence or ability.
To cover their responsibilities from every
point of view, the "pivot boys" hide themselves behind those
whom they call their "superior officers." Now, who are
these "superior officers?". They are evidently the members
of the Shanghai Municipal Council. It is these members who
make decisions after having considered them; it is they who
have to deal with any delicate situation caused by the Sino-
Japanese conflict in Shanghai. The "pivot boys" are only
the adjutants who carry out the decisions of the Council.
It does not require a person to be "a son of
Jupiter" to look after a finance department which is certainly
not of greater importance than that of the Banque de l'Indo-
Chine or of the Hongkong and Shanghai Bank; it does not require
a second Pasteur to direct, badly than well, a health department;
and lastly, it does not require a Registrar of a Court or of a
Court of Appeal to carry out efficiently the duties of a
secretary or even of a Secretary-General to the S.M.C. There
are probably in Shanghai two or three hundred persons who are
perfectly capable of undertaking these duties and everything

- 5 -

第20页

“核心人物”

公共租界所谓“核心人物”一事，不仅表明局势令人极为遗憾，也伴有一些颇具讽刺意味的枝节问题。当纳税人被告知，他们每月需向这些人支付5,000至7,000美元，且不包括免费通行、医疗服务、退休金等额外特权时，人们不禁会对如此高昂的薪金感到震惊。这不仅是因为我们正身处艰难时世，更主要的是，这些绅士的工作，无论其性质如何微妙，并不需要超出常人的智力或能力。

为了从各方面推卸责任，“核心人物”们躲在他们所谓的“上级官员”身后。那么，这些“上级官员”是谁呢？显然就是上海工部局董事会的成员。正是这些成员在审议后作出决定；正是他们必须处理因上海中日冲突而引起的任何微妙局势。“核心人物”仅仅是执行董事会决定的副官。

管理一个财务部门并不需要成为“朱庇特之子”，该部门的重要性肯定不及东方汇理银行或汇丰银行；指导卫生部门（无论是做得好还是坏）也不需要第二个巴斯德；最后，高效地履行秘书甚至工部局总干事的职责，也不需要法院或上诉法院的书记官。上海大概有两三百人完全有能力承担这些职责，而关于“核心人物”那些珍贵、独特且不可或缺品质的种种说法，纯属徒劳的空谈。

that one relates about the precious, unique and indispensable
qualities of the "pivot boys" is so much fruitless talk.
Finally, as has been remarked by all the news-
papers in Shanghai, with the exception of one or two whose
instructions are to hold their tongue and to admire (our
readers will not be seized with an attack of meningitis in
trying to guess who they are), it was a shame to increase
by 60 to 100% the salaries of a few of the higher officials
who are already being paid from $2,000 to $4,000 a month,
whilst the immense mass of small and humble employees,
especially those who have to walk about the whole day long,
in all kinds of weather, such as the inspectors of the various
services, the staff of the Police Department, the Fire Brigade,
etc. etc., are being paid a modest salary of several hundred
dollars, ameliorated by only 15%.
It is such acts as this that, in other countries,
produces revolutions.

or excited, who believe or who pretend that the existence of
Communist menace in China is only a wicked excuse invented by
the Japanese to justify their invasion of this country. That
the excuse was a debatable question is a point that one can
equally support. One may, for example, consider that Japan

We recall to our readers a recent affair over which
there appears to have been spread a conspiracy of silence and
which is as abominable as the abduction and assassination in

所谓“核心少年”（pivot boys）具备珍贵、独特且不可或缺的品质，这种说法纯属徒劳的空谈。
最后，正如上海所有报纸所指出的那样——除了一两家奉命保持缄默并一味赞美的报纸（读者在猜测其身份时不会患上脑膜炎），将少数高级官员的薪金提高60%至100%是一种耻辱，这些高官的月薪本已高达2,000至4,000美元；与此同时，广大卑微的低级职员，特别是那些无论天气如何都需终日奔波的人员，如各处的稽查员、警务处人员、消防队队员等，仅拿着数百美元的微薄薪水，增幅仅为15%。
正是此类行径，在其他国家会引发革命。
----------
第21页
有许多人变得愤怒或激动，他们相信或假装相信，中国存在的共产主义威胁只是日本人为证明其入侵该国正当性而编造的邪恶借口。这一借口是否站得住脚，是一个人们同样可以支持的观点。例如，人们可以认为，日本无需担心苏联可能或未来吞并中国。但是，否认这种毫无疑问的事态存在，则是荒谬的，甚至可能是犯罪的，除非是愚人或那些有特殊理由质疑证据的人。
我们要向读者回顾最近发生的一件事，对此事似乎存在着一种沉默的共谋，其恶劣程度不亚于绑架和暗杀

Paris of two Russian Generals named Koutiepoff and Miller.
Proceeding from the same causes and producing the same
effects, the abduction and disappearance of eleven White
Russians by the Chinese Authorities at Hankow prior to the
arrival of the Japanese are significant.

It is known that these Russians come from good
families several of whom held good positions. Scandalized
lines have been dedicated to their disappearance, even in
the "Shanghai Evening Post." Since then --- silence. There
probably remain only the widows and the orphans and the memory
of the victims sacrificed by the reds.

At Peking, the Postal Commissioner, Mr. Poletti,
who made the mistake of sympathizing with the new order, has
also been abducted and perhaps murdered by the so-called red
guerrillas.

最近，孙科发表了一篇演讲，某些报纸对此大肆渲染，乐在其中。

如果你知道一辆黄包车在五分钟前刚刚运送过一具中国人的尸体，此人可能死于霍乱或天花，你会允许你的妻子或孩子（甚至是你的岳母）乘坐这辆黄包车吗？
- 你自己会乘坐这样的黄包车吗？
即使不去想象这辆黄包车曾运送过令人悲伤的人类遗体，你会使用它吗？或者，如果你知道这辆黄包车刚刚将一名处于伤寒、天花或猩红热末期的病人送往一家小型华人医院，你会允许你的家人使用它吗？

你会回答说，那是愚蠢的！好吧，亲爱的读者，你每天都在犯这种愚蠢的错误，正是因为不仅有保佑醉汉的天意，也有保佑你我的天意，我们才没有更频繁地成为这种难以置信局势的受害者。因为你一定不止一次注意到，黄包车载着一个人，无论男女，裹在毯子里，通常由另一名中国人搀扶着。

你可曾花哪怕一秒钟去思考，被运送的这个“人形物体”可能是什么？你认为这可能是一位因为要去见情人而 modestly 遮掩面容的美丽女子吗？或者可能是一个不想被钱庄职员认出来的人？又或者是一位躲避公众欢呼的中日战争英雄？

你很清楚事实并非如此。那是一个病人，或许已经是一个死人。

Chinese, who had died perhaps of cholera or small-pox?
- Would you yourself ride in such a ricshaw?
Without even imagining that this ricshaw had
carried the sorrowful human remains, could you use it? Or
would you allow your family to use it knowing that the ricshaw
in question had just transported to a small Chinese hospital
a case of typhoid or small-pox or scarlet fever at its last
stage?
That, you reply, would be folly! Well, dear
reader, this folly you are committing every day and it is
because there is truly a Providence not only for the drunk
but also for you and me that we are not more often victims
in this unbelievable state of affairs. For you must have
often noticed, more than once,ricshaws transporting a person,
man or woman, envelopped in a blanket and generally supported
in the arms of an other Chinese.
Have you even reflected a second upon what may
perhaps have been this human thing that was being transported?
Do you think that it might be a beautiful woman who had
modestly concealed her features because she is going to meet
her lover? Or may be it was some person who did not want
to be recognized by the shroffs? Or perhaps it is a hero
of the Sino-Japanese war who is hiding himself to escape
from the acclamation of the public?
You know very well it is not. It is a sick
person and perhaps an already dead person.
Read the statistics of the sick and dead in the
Foreign Settlements. You will find that every year some
50,000 dead bodies are retrieved from the streets in Shanghai
of which 90% are corpses of infants, mostly girls.
If only one out of ten sick persons carried by
ricshaws is a contagious case, the danger is great; and
should you, after reading the above, notice on your way to
office, ricshaws carrying persons suspiciously envelopped

阅读一下外国租界的病患和死亡统计数据。你会发现，上海每年从街道上收殓的尸体约有50,000具，其中90%是婴儿尸体，且多为女婴。

如果每十个由黄包车运送的病人中有一个是传染病病例，危险就很大；如果你在读了上述内容后，在去办公室的路上注意到载着可疑地裹在毯子里的人的黄包车——如果你冷漠地看待这一切，那么第二天如果你自己或任何家庭成员患病，只能怪你自己以及这几乎令人难以置信的局势。

卫生部门感到震惊，并因某人家门前出现几棵白菜梗（受罚者对此可能有解释）或因某人在院子里存放了一些废铁或铁器而处以罚款。但是，对于患有传染病并被用黄包车运送的人——或其家属——应处以何种罚款？黄包车车主也应因未禁止其车夫运送明显生病的人而受到罚款。

警方难道不应采取必要行动吗？他们应当护送每一辆载有被认为患有严重疾病者的黄包车前往最近的警察局。

第29页

当人们想到，工部局可以将数十万美元放入其主要雇员的圣诞袜中，并且不情愿地将其几名音乐家借给俄罗斯芭蕾舞团的管弦乐队，却尚未向这个作为芭蕾舞和歌剧演出场所既有用又不可或缺的组织提供几千美元的补贴（法国公董局也未提供），面对这种自私和冷漠，人们感到困惑。

在任何国家和所有大型首都，都有由国家或市政府资助的剧院。

因此，值得提倡的是——这也是所有观看过俄罗斯芭蕾舞或歌剧的人士的意见——由两个市政机构向其组织者提供适度的补贴。

of affairs if on the morrow you yourself or any member of
your family is stricken.

The Health Departments are shocked and impose
fines because of the presence of a few cabbage stalks in
front of one's their houses (for which the persons fined may have
an explanation) or because somebody has some scrap iron or
iron utensils in his courtyard. But what fine should be
imposed on a person --- or his family --- who, suffering from
an infectious disease, is transported in a ricshaw. The
owner of the ricshaw should also be fined for not prohibiting
his coolies from transporting persons who are evidently sick.

Should not the Police take the necessary action?
They should escort to the nearest Police Station every
ricshaw transporting a person believed to be suffering from
some grave malady.

--------

Page 27

In a case of divorce between two foreigners
amenable to the jurisdiction of the Chinese Courts, the
husband (plaintiff) had to pay more than $17,000 in fees
during the two years that the case lasted and without
obtaining any result! The wife (respondent) being better
off, had to spend a still larger amount! At the end, the
case reached an impasse for with every difficulty that arose
it was made the excuse for a demand for more costs.

------

Page 29.-

When one reflects that the S.M.C. can put
hundreds of thousands of dollars into the Christmas
stockings of its principal employees and that it reluctantly
page_data.zh:
- 9 -

裹着毯子——如果你对此漠然视之，那么当明日你本人或任何家庭成员染病时，只能怪罪你自己以及这几乎令人难以置信的现状。

卫生部门感到震惊并处以罚款，原因仅仅是某人家门前有几棵菜帮子（受罚者对此或许另有解释），或者因为某人的院子里有一些废铁或铁器。但是，对于患有传染病并由人力车运送的人——或其家属——应处以何种罚款呢？人力车车主也应因未禁止其车夫运送明显患病之人而受到罚款。

警方难道不应采取必要行动吗？他们应当将每一辆运送疑似患有严重疾病患者的人力车护送至最近的警察局。

--------

第27页

在两名为中国法院管辖的外国人离婚案中，丈夫（原告）在历时两年的诉讼过程中支付了超过17,000美元的费用，却未获得任何结果！妻子（被告）因经济状况较好，不得不花费更多的金额！最终，案件陷入僵局，因为出现的每一个困难都成了要求支付更多费用的借口。

------

第29页.-

当人们想到上海工部局（S.M.C.）能够向其主要雇员发放数十万美元的圣诞礼金，而其却勉强地

page_data.en:
- 10 -
lends several of its musicians to the orchestra of the Russian
Ballet, that it has not yet given a subsidy --- neither has
the French Municipality for that matter --- of a few thousand
dollars to this organization which is useful and indispensable
as a theatre for ballets and operas, one is confounded before
such selfishness and indifference.
In any country and in all the large capitals,
there are theatres subsided by the State or by the
Municipalities.
It would, therefore, be desirable --- and that
is the opinion of all persons who have attended the Russian
ballets or operas --- that a modest subsidy should be granted
to their organizers by the two Municipalities.
page_data.zh:
- 10 -
鉴于该机构将其数名乐手借予俄罗斯芭蕾舞团管弦乐队，而工部局至今未向这一作为芭蕾舞和歌剧演出场所且有益且不可或缺的组织提供数千美元的补贴——法公董局亦未提供——面对如此自私与冷漠，人们不禁感到愕然。
在任何国家及所有大型首都，均有由国家或市政当局资助的剧院。
因此，若能由两市政当局向其组织者提供一笔适度的补贴，将是可取的——这也是所有观赏过俄罗斯芭蕾舞或歌剧的人士所持的观点。

Station Foreign Affairs, C.S.B File No. Date May 10, 1943.
SUBJECT: KALANDAR (or the S.R.) Russian monthly magazine - Application for registration.

The original application for registration of a new monthly magazine in the Russian language entitled "Kalandar" (or the S.R.) was received on 15-11-41 from Mr. B.F. Ignatenko, editor and publisher. It is of interest to note that in the application form the Russian Emigrants Committee was mentioned as the proprietor of the proposed magazine, but that on 28-12-41 a notice appeared in the Russian press denying the existence of any connection between the Committee and the magazine. For reasons unknown, the magazine never appeared and therefore on 15-3-42 registration certificate No 163 issued in respect of this publication and never called for, was forwarded for cancellation.

The application was renewed early in April, 1943, this time with Mr. B.F. Ignatenko as the proprietor, publisher and editor. It was declared that the magazine is intended to be "an anti-communist organ propagating White Russian policy". The initial capital is stated to be $8,000 and the circulation - 500 copies (sale price $10.00 per copy). Both the editorial and printing offices of the magazine are located in the French Concession at 209/1 Avenue Haig (T.76333) and 535 Rue Cardinal Mercier (T.74080), respectively. On 1-4-43 the magazine was registered with the French Police (Certificate No 1122), following which an announcement appeared in the Russian press on 11-4-43 to the effect that the magazine will make its first appearance on 25-4-43.

This warning, it would appear, was given by the Intelligence in consideration of the fact that the main promoters of the magazine are Messrs S.S. Ignatenko A.N. Shliapin and N. Novans, all of whom are known in the community on account of their past and/or present connections with certain organs of the Japanese Intelligence Service. Apparently, it was considered that the possibility was not unlikely of an undue advantage being taken of this fact by the said persons or their sub-agents in order to boost their enterprise.

It is reported that the initial capital of $60,000 was collected mainly by Shliapin and was comprised of loans, donations and proceeds from the sale of advertising space. So far, no complaints are known to have been made in connection with this matter.

Before the magazine made its first appearance, a split, the origin of which is rather obscure, took place between N. Novans on one side and Ignatenko and Shliapin on the other ( the latter two individuals are known to have been working together for the past year or so ). 在该杂志首次出版之前，N. 诺万斯一方与伊格纳坚科和什利亚平另一方之间发生了分裂，其起因相当模糊（后两人已知在过去一年左右一直合作）。作为分裂的结果，俄文报刊于1943年4月15日刊登了以下通告：-

致广告商注意

“鉴于日本人最近在《新时报》和《上海日报》上发布的通告，特此普遍告知，与之相关的活动归《纳卡努马》（Nakanuma）杂志管辖，且来自该杂志编辑部的所有通讯仅限于其自1943年3月29日起与其合作的事实，即就其提案而言，严格限于‘爱国主义、支持保卫俄罗斯、苏联和犹太人’的运动”

《纳卡努马》杂志
编辑部。

几天前，卢琴科（Loutchenko）先生向本处提供了 dated 1943年4月21日的首期杂志副本，该期杂志已印刷完毕，但在工部局警务处审查办公室批准之前暂不发行。通过审阅其内容，可以清楚地看出该杂志主要具有政治性质：-

“如果我们能在一定程度上填补东亚地区缺乏独立的、不受外国影响的、探讨俄罗斯未来问题的俄国流亡政治和社会新闻机构所造成的空白，那么我们期刊的任务就算完成了”

“我们杂志的目的是促进：在不可调和地反对共产主义的基础上，统一俄国流亡者中积极且具有政治意识的少数派；使我们的民族世界观形成明确的形态，并宣传进行民族政治训练的必要性；彻底修订俄国流亡者破产的意识形态价值观，以便找到以俄罗斯的名义开展实际和创造性工作的切实途径。

“我们要向那些拥有坚强意志和远见的人，向那些强大而勇敢的人发出呼吁！”

(3) The communist experiment in Russia as well as the
attempt to create instead of Russia a " base for the
world revolution" have failed. The ideas of the "doct-
rine of Marx, Lenin and Stalin" have already no power
over the minds of the best elements within the country.
After 25 years of unceasing struggle against the com-
munist rulers for their national existence the peoples
of Russia are coming out victorious.

(4) We are on the eve of beneficial changes which inevi-
tably will take place within the USSR irrespective of

(5) Only victory over the communist regime obtained from
within will safeguard a favourable for Russia's future
outcome of the war against her external enemies. Only
National Government will be able to conclude a peace
safeguarding national independence and territorial in-
tegrity of Russia and to carry out the work of recon-
struction and to cure the terrible wounds inflicted on
her by two wars and 25 years of communist regime.

(6) We are firmly convinced that the communist-interna-
tionalist ruling clique still has the power in the USSR
and is organically incapable of any evolution towards
the ideas of Russian National State.
At the same time we firmly believe and know that

ments within the USSR are characterized with the same

(7) The question now put by the history is this: how
soon this new elite of the USSR will be able to seize
the government apparatus ( the military apparatus is

to direct it for the service to the truly Russian na-
tional interests.

(2) 继伪民主和社会主义思想的时代之后，一个新时代正在到来，它将决定人类数千年的命运，并宣告“民族”是人类生活的最高价值，以取代自给自足的个人主义和非人格化的集体主义。

(3) 俄罗斯的共产主义实验以及试图将俄罗斯变成“世界革命基地”的企图已经失败。“马克思、列宁和斯大林学说”的思想已经不再对该国最优秀阶层的思想具有影响力。在与共产主义统治者为了民族生存进行了25年不间断的斗争后，俄罗斯人民正走向胜利。

(4) 我们正处于有益变革的前夜，无论当前苏德战争的结果如何，这些变革都将在苏联境内不可避免地发生。

(5) 只有从内部战胜共产主义政权，才能确保俄罗斯在对抗外部敌人的战争中取得有利于其未来的结果。只有民族政府才能缔结保障俄罗斯民族独立和领土完整的和平，开展重建工作，并治愈两场战争和25年共产主义政权给她带来的可怕创伤。

(6) 我们坚信，共产主义-国际主义统治集团仍然在苏联掌握权力，并且在有机上无法向俄罗斯民族国家的思想演变。
同时，我们坚定地相信并知道，俄罗斯大众已经放弃了1917-1920年间特有的国际主义-共产主义倾向。目前，尽管国际主义-共产主义政府做出了一切努力，苏联境内的最优秀阶层所表现出的民族主义情感，与俄罗斯精英阶层一贯的表现相同。

(7) 历史现在提出的问题是：苏联的这一新精英阶层需要多久才能夺取政府机构（军事机构已在很大程度上掌握在他们手中），并将其引导至为真正的俄罗斯民族利益服务。

(8) 那些依靠外国人将祖国从共产主义枷锁中解放出来，并试图证明西方进行的所谓“反布尔什维克十字军东征”具有利他性质，随后将在“俄罗斯解放区建立某种民主政府”的俄罗斯流亡者，是错误的且 misguided。所有此类以及其他

page_data.en:
BRIEF INFORMATION ABOUT MAGAZINE "ON THE EVE."

1. The aim of publication - to create solid printing organ
in Russian of general public political ideas, in order
to establish the propaganda of national-improving and cultural
civilizing work amongst Russian emigrants on the basis
of irreconciliability to communism and dark powers which support
same, the struggle with pro-soviet and other harmful influences
among emigrants. To oppose to them the ideas of national
character and New Order in Great Eastern Asia. popularisation
amongst young generation of national-good will ideas in order to
prepare them to responsible serving to Russian nation, which
appears in the flames of present war in the place of international
U.S.S.R. Calls to awakening its unity.

2. Editor of the magazine and publisher A.F. Ignatenko,
biographical information of whom is attached herewith.

3. The following persons are participation in the magazine:
N.N. Grosin 100/3 Route Paul Emery-Russian publicist and writer
Y. Lovich 335 Cardinal Mercier - writer, the author
of many books, the editor of magazine of Russian emigrants
Committee "Grani." V.V. Muhanoff-assistant manager of
Broadway Mansions Hotel. Z.V. Pinaev. Empire Apartment,
the dentist, in charge of girls section of Scouts organisation
in Shanghai.

A.V. Popov 1662 Great Western Road, the former editor of
the newspaper "New Times," publicist and writer. The chairman
of Baikal Cossacks. A.A. Purin 9916 Macgregor Rd, employer of
Japanese Embassy, publicist and writer. M.A. Putziato-the
teacher and lector of Russian Commercial Institute.

P.A. Savintzeff in charge of Cultural Educational department
of Russian emigrants Committee-the writer of leading articles
of the newspaper "New Times." F. Skopichenko 559D, Rue
Lafayette well known national writer. B. R. Novans Cathay
Hotel Room 741, the employer of Imperial Japanese Naval
Headquarters, actor and publicist. A.N. Shlyapin 209 Av. Haig.
Aptl. has connection in political work with many Japanese
leader in Tokyo-merchant; and many other leaders of Russian
emigrants colony of Shanghai who are leading anti-communistic
activity and co-operating with New Order in Great Eastern Asia,
intellectually prepared to serious propaganda work.

4. The following questions will be published in the magazine,
which are necessary for national awakening of emigrants:
in order to paralyze harmful to them and to New Order influences

1. The questions of national character
2. The structure of New Order in Great Eastern Asia.
3. Objective survey of the world's events.
4. Systematical survey of the events in U.S.S.R.
5. Up to date questions of emigrants
6. The aims of Russian emigrants young generation.
7. Literature creative power.
8. Bibliography.
9. News of science and technical Knowledge.
10. Reader's page
11. Humour.
12. Cross word puzzles, riddles, and problems.

IGNATENKO BORIS FEODOROVICH

was born on 4th December 1916 in Harbin. Graduated from
Russian High School in Imianpo station (Mangouo) and then was
studying for two years in University of Law in Harbin.

Was working in the editorial office of the newspaper "Our Way"
till it was closed (January 1938) also was working in the
magazines "Fiction" "Seams of Asia" and many other young
generation editions of the 2nd branch of the Bureau of Russian
emigrants.

In the beginning of 1938 left for Tientsin, where was employed
in Special branch of railway police, was transferred to the
headquarters of said branch in Peking, where was employed till
April of 1940, being in charge of the office of the branch.

Simultaneously while in Peking was the editor of the newspaper
"The way of young Generation;" and also was working in the
newspapers "Regeneration of Asia" and "Peking Chronicle."

On 15th May of 1940 arrived in Harbin, from where on 12th July
of the same year left for Shanghai.

From 22nd July of 1940 to November 1941 was working in the
office of Mayor Urano on Soviet and emigrants questions,
simultaneously was also working at the special branch of Russian
emigrants committee till it was abolished, and also in the
newspaper. Far Eastern Times, then in "Russian Times."
left the work in the newspaper on 15th January 1942.

At present time is working in Japanese firm "Dosei Koiki"
Room 101 Liza Building from 1934 entered Russian Fascist Union, where
was working in the branch of studying U.S.S.R. and also in
political section of the secretariat, performing the duties of the
head of agitation branch.

My mother Ignatenko Natalia Ivanovna 50 years old, and my
step-father Medvedeff Peter Stepanovich,-employee of Mantezu
are living in Harbin. Sister Valentine 23 years old is employed
as stenographer in Special branch of railway police in Peking,
brother Leonid 21 years old in Tientsin, who graduated Far Eastern
University in Tientsin and who is employed in Anti-Comintern
Committee at Tientsin. Single.

B. Ignatenko.

IGNATENKO BORIS FEODOROVICH

1916年12月4日出生于哈尔滨。毕业于一面坡站（满洲国）俄罗斯中学，随后在哈尔滨法科大学学习了两年。

在《我们的道路》（Our Way）报社编辑部工作直至该报关闭（1938年1月），还曾在《小说》（Fiction）、《亚洲 seams》（Seams of Asia，原文如此，可能指《亚洲脉络》或类似名称）以及俄罗斯流亡者局第二处的许多其他青年刊物工作。

1938年初前往天津，受雇于铁路警察特别分支，后被调往该分支位于北京的总部，在那里工作至1940年4月，负责该分支的办公室事务。

在北京期间，同时担任《青年一代之路》（The way of young Generation）报纸编辑；并在《亚洲复兴》（Regeneration of Asia）和《北京纪事》（Peking Chronicle）报纸工作。

1940年5月15日抵达哈尔滨，同年7月12日从那里前往上海。

1940年7月22日至1941年11月，在浦野（Urano）市长办公室处理苏联及流亡者问题，同时在俄罗斯流亡者委员会特别分支工作直至该分支被撤销，并在《远东时报》（Far Eastern Times）工作，随后在《俄罗斯时报》（Russian Times）工作。于1942年1月15日离开报社工作。

目前在日本公司“Dosei Koiki”（音译，可能指“同生广报”或类似机构）工作，丽萨大楼（Liza Building）101室。1934年加入俄罗斯法西斯联盟，在研究苏联的分支以及秘书处的政治部门工作，履行宣传分支负责人的职责。

我的母亲 Ignatenko Natalia Ivanovna，50岁，继父 Medvedeff Peter Stepanovich，万泰祖（Mantezu，音译）雇员，居住在哈尔滨。姐姐 Valentine，23岁，在北京铁路警察特别分支担任速记员，弟弟 Leonid，21岁，在天津，毕业于天津远东大学，受雇于天津的反共产国际委员会。未婚。

B. Ignatenko.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

S.4-A, Cr. & Sp. Branch. STATION. File No. .................... Date January 4, 1943.

SUBJECT: Daily War News - Application for Re-Registration.

Forwarded herewith is an application from I. Greenetz and K. Peder for re-registration of the "Daily War News", a daily bulletin in the English language. The joint proprietors and publishers of the said bulletin is "The Epoch Publishing Co.", 60 Love Lane, represented by the following 4 persons :- MESSRS Mr. I. Greenetz, Jakheim, Shvetzov and Rogoff.

Mr. I. Greenetz arrived in Shanghai from Mukden on 18th October, 1939, and is a merchant. Mr. V. Rogoff is the Director of "Tass News Service", and Mr. Shvetzov is the Vice-Director of the said establishment.

The proprietors being Soviet citizens are contributing the capital, $250,000.00, and distributing the bulletin with the news about the German-Soviet war in English language for the benefit of those who do not understand Russian.

Mr. K. Peder is the chief editor of the said bulletin, which will be printed at 319 Wuting Road. A circulation of 3,000. copies is anticipated and will be sold for 20 cents per copy.

Nothing to the detriment of the applicants is known to this office.

K. S. Algasin
D. S.

Officer i/c Censorship Section.

D.C. (Cr. & Sp. Branch).

报告

S.4-A，刑事及特别处。分局。档案号 .................... 日期 1943 年 1 月 4 日。

主题：《每日战讯》 - 重新登记申请。

兹转呈 I. Greenetz 和 K. Peder 关于英文日报《每日战讯》(Daily War News) 的重新登记申请。该公报的共同业主及出版人为“时代出版公司”(The Epoch Publishing Co.)，地址为爱多亚路 (Love Lane) 60 号，由以下四人代表：I. Greenetz 先生、Jakheim 先生、Shvetzov 先生和 Rogoff 先生。

I. Greenetz 先生于 1939 年 10 月 18 日从沈阳抵达上海，是一名商人。V. Rogoff 先生是“塔斯社新闻服务处”的主管，Shvetzov 先生是该机构的副主管。

业主均为苏联公民，出资 250,000.00 美元，并以英文分发有关苏德战争的新闻公报，以供不懂俄语的人士阅读。

K. Peder 先生是该公报的主编，将在武定路 319 号印刷。预计发行量为 3,000 份，售价为每份 20 分。

本局未发现任何不利于申请人的情况。

K. S. Algasin
D. S.

审查科主管官员。

D.C. （刑事及特别处）。

page_data.en:
Daily War News
PUBLISHED BY THE EPOCH MAGAZINE
4.00 P.M. SHANGHAI, MONDAY, AUGUST 4, 1941 GRATIS

Important German Towns Laid in Ruins

Widespread Havoc Caused
By R.A.F.

At Least One-Third Of Aachen And Muenster Have Been
Destroyed; Churchill's Promises To Bring War To Germans
Being Made Good.

London, July 20.
At least one-third of the towns of Aachen and Muenster have been
destroyed, says the Ministry News Service, adding that casualties must
have been heavy and that the damage will need several months of
intensive labour to repair.

Aachen was "thoroughly plastered" on
the night of July 10 though it had been
previously attack and loads of high-
explosive bombs and 7,000 incendiaries
fell on the town. Almost every bomb
reached its intended target and damage
subsequently confirmed by reconnaissance
is described as "terrific."

WIDESPREAD HAVOC
Damage was mostly in the centre, but
no part of the town escaped bombing,
causing widespread havoc and many areas
suffered from blasts.

Muenster, described in a recent German
broadcast as "that unhappy city," tells
the same tale. In five recent raids entire
areas were completely burned out includ-
ing industrial and residential buildings.

CHURCHILL'S PROMISES
FULFILLED

One single heavy bomb devastated an area
of more than 7,000 square yards and
another had a similar effect covering 6,000
square yards. These two areas were
demolished and are surrounded by much
larger areas of fire and blast-damaged
buildings.

After enumerating districts in Muenster
most completely gutted by fire the Air
Ministry News Service says other districts

Enemy Warships
at Palermo Bombed

Four Ships In Convoy
Probably Destroyed In
Another R.A.F. Attack
(Reuter)

Cairo, July 29.
Another successful attack was carried
out by British heavy bombers on a cruiser
and destroyers in Palermo harbour on
Thursday night, states a Middle East
communique. Bombs were dropped on and
near the warships' but full results could
not be seen. Over Cyprus, R.A.F. fighters
engaged two Junkers which dropped
bombs on Friday. One enemy plane was
shot down.

Nazis Claim Fall
of Novagrad

Advance Said Made From
Kiev; Moscow Reported
Heavily Bombed
(Reuter)

London, July 19.
Capture of Novograd and Volynak, 130
miles west at Kiev, is claimed by the
German official news agency.
The German radio alleges that Smo-
lensk was set on fire by the Russians
before their evacuation of the town, but
Moscow continues to deny capture of
Smolensk by the Germans, stating that
fighting is taking place 100 miles to the
west. London announced this morning.

AUSTRALIAN CASUALTY
FIGURES GIVEN
(United Press)

Sydney, July 20.
Total Australian casualties — killed,
wounded, missing and taken prisoner—
in Syria up to July 16 were 117 officers
and 1,565 men, it was announced here
yesterday.
Twenty-six officers and 210 men were
killed in action and 73 officers and 976
men were wounded in action.

每日战讯
由《时代杂志》出版
下午 4:00 上海，1941年8月4日，星期一 免费

德国重要城镇沦为废墟

皇家空军
造成广泛破坏

亚琛和明斯特至少三分之一被毁；丘吉尔将战争带给德国人的承诺正在兑现。

伦敦，7月20日。
据新闻部消息处称，亚琛（Aachen）和明斯特（Muenster）两镇至少有三分之一被毁，并补充说伤亡必然惨重，修复损坏需要数月的高强度劳动。

尽管此前曾遭受攻击，亚琛在7月10日晚仍被“彻底轰炸”，大量高爆炸弹和7,000枚燃烧弹落在该镇。几乎每枚炸弹都击中了预定目标，随后经侦察确认的损害被形容为“巨大”。

广泛破坏
损害主要集中在中心区，但该镇没有任何地方逃脱轰炸，造成广泛破坏，许多地区受到冲击波影响。

明斯特在最近的一次德国广播中被形容为“那座不幸的城市”，情况同样如此。在最近五次空袭中，包括工业和住宅建筑在内的整个区域被完全烧毁。

丘吉尔的承诺
得以实现

一枚重型炸弹摧毁了超过7,000平方码的区域，另一枚产生了类似效果，覆盖了6,000平方码。这两个区域被夷为平地，周围环绕着更大范围的火灾和受冲击波损坏的建筑物。

在列举了明斯特被大火彻底烧空的地区后，空军部新闻处称其他地区

敌军舰艇
在巴勒莫遭轰炸

护航队中的四艘船只
可能在另一次皇家空军
袭击中被摧毁
（路透社）

开罗，7月29日。
中东公报称，英国重型轰炸机于周四晚对巴勒莫港的一艘巡洋舰和驱逐舰进行了另一次成功的袭击。炸弹投掷在军舰上及其附近，但无法看清全部战果。在塞浦路斯上空，皇家空军战斗机与两架于周五投掷炸弹的容克式飞机交战。一架敌机被击落。

纳粹声称
诺夫哥罗德陷落

称从基辅取得进展；据报道
莫斯科遭到猛烈轰炸
（路透社）

伦敦，7月19日。
德国官方通讯社声称占领了位于基辅以西130英里的诺夫哥罗德-沃伦斯基（Novograd and Volynak）。
德国电台声称，斯摩棱斯克在俄国人撤离该镇前被其放火焚烧，但莫斯科继续否认德国人占领斯摩棱斯克，称战斗正在向西100英里处进行。伦敦今早宣布。

公布澳大利亚
伤亡数字
（合众社）

悉尼，7月20日。
此处昨日宣布，截至7月16日，澳大利亚在叙利亚的总伤亡人数——阵亡、受伤、失踪和被俘——为军官117名，士兵1,565名。
26名军官和210名士兵在战斗中阵亡，73名军官和976名士兵在战斗中受伤。

ITALO-GERMAN NAVAL CO OPERATION IMPOSSIBLE.

GENEVA. March 22 (TASS) Commenting on the official reports about Admiral
Denitse's Rome visit, the local political circles are very sceptical as regards
the possibilities of an "Italo - German naval cooperation." The reports received
in the past few weeks from well informed sources stressed the continued aggravation
of the dispute between the chief Axis partners regrading the use of the Italian
Navy and more specifically- the submarine fleet on various theatres of war. The
German insistent demands for detailing strong Italian naval forces for the
operations in the Atlantic Ocean and in the northern seas, encountered a vigorous
opposition of the Rome naval circles and has become a subject of long , fruitless
discussions between the Italians and the Germans. Under various pretexts the
Italians stubbornly defended the principle of "local operations" of the navy as
opposed to the doctrine of "total submarine war ", proclaimed by Denits. The rumours
of Denitse's impending visit to Italy for the "settlement of problems of first
rate importance" have long been current in Rome. It is now stated, that the
recent Italian denial of the differences between the Italian and German naval
staffs was published under the direct pressure of the Germans, since the rumours
about these differences reached the general public. According to the most recent
reports from Rome - in the course of his talks with Riccardi - Denits presented
to Italy a virtual ultimatum, demanding the wide use of the Italian submarine and
surface fleets and urging immediate action in view of the heavy losses sustained
by the German navy in the Atlantic. However, the point of view of the prominent
representatives of the Italian naval circles after the Denitz- Riccardi negotiations
in essence does not differ from the former attitude of the Italian Naval Ministry
and manifestly runs counter to the official communiques. These circles state, that
Italy must do her utmost for the preservation of her naval forces "which will be
of very big importance for the national policy". It is rumoured, that in view of
the failure of the Rome negotiations - Denitz, on behalf of the German Government,
invited Riccardi to Berlin . (TASS)

意德海军合作不可能。

日内瓦，3月22日（塔斯社）当地政治界对关于邓尼茨（Denitse）海军上将访问罗马的官方报道持非常怀疑的态度，认为“意德海军合作”的可能性存疑。过去几周从消息灵通人士处收到的报道强调，轴心国主要伙伴之间关于意大利海军、特别是潜艇部队在各个战区的使用问题上的争端持续加剧。德国坚持要求抽调强大的意大利海军力量用于大西洋和北部海域的行动，遭到了罗马海军界的强烈反对，并成为意德之间长期且无果讨论的主题。意大利人以各种借口顽固地捍卫海军“局部作战”的原则，反对邓尼茨（Denits）宣扬的“全面潜艇战”学说。关于邓尼茨即将访问意大利以“解决头等重要性问题”的传闻在罗马流传已久。现在据说，最近意大利否认意德海军参谋部之间存在分歧的说法是在德国的直接压力下发布的，因为有关这些分歧的传闻已传至公众耳中。根据来自罗马的最新报道——在与里卡尔迪（Riccardi）的会谈中——邓尼茨向意大利提出了事实上的最后通牒，要求广泛使用意大利潜艇和水面舰队，并鉴于德国海军在大西洋遭受的重大损失，敦促立即采取行动。然而，在邓尼茨-里卡尔迪谈判后，意大利海军界重要代表的观点本质上与意大利海军部以前的态度并无不同，且显然与官方公报相悖。这些圈子表示，意大利必须竭尽全力保护其海军力量，“这对国家政策至关重要”。有传闻称，鉴于罗马谈判失败——邓尼茨代表德国政府邀请里卡尔迪前往柏林。（塔斯社）

Slavyanskaya in Kuban Cleared of Nazi Invaders
7,000 Germans Killed, 140 Tanks Destroyed in Battle North of Zhisdra

52,000 Germans Killed On Donets-River Front
MOSCOW, March 25. — Lately the hitlerites have been displaying especial zeal in the fabrication of all kinds of mendacious "military communiques". With a single stroke of the pen they destroy on the paper dozens of Soviet infantry, motorized, and tank formations.

Thus, for instance, on March 20th, the German Information Bureau published a report, affirming that since February 13th, in the area between the Northern Donets and the Dniepr rivers, 9 Soviet infantry divisions, 6 infantry brigades, 4 cavalry divisions, 9 mechanized brigades, 29 tank brigades, 2 tank regiments, and one brigade of anti-tank guns had allegedly been destroyed.

However, this seemed insufficient for the Germans, and the German report went on to state, that in addition, heavy losses were sustained by 19 infantry divisions, 18 motorized and tank brigades, as well as by other Red Army formations and units.

In order to lend semblance of veracity to this throughout false report, the German fabricators cited the first numbers that occurred to them, as those of the allegedly destroyed Soviet divisions and brigades.

Suffice it to say, that there never have been Soviet formations under such numbers in the area between the Northern Donets and Dniepr rivers, as reported by the German information Bureau. Some divisions and brigades, mentioned by the hitlerites as if destroyed, generally never existed in the Red Army, while many of them did not take part in the fighting in the South and, therefore, could not have been destroyed, nor could not lose their bases.

At the end of February, the German Command launched a counter-offensive in the area between the Northern Donets and Dniepr rivers, in an attempt to surround the Soviet troops and stage for them a "German Stalingrad". For this purpose the Germans urgently transferred a large number of fresh infantry and tank divisions from Western Europe to the areas of fighting, and also transferred from Germany 110 to 115 replacement battalions from Germany to replenish their shattered formations.

In general, the Germans now dream of a revenge for Stalingrad, but nothing came of it, and their scheme fell through completely. Fighting violent delaying actions and inflicting heavy losses on the enemy, our troops, on the

MOSCOW, March 24. — The Evening Communique of the Soviet Information Bureau of March 23rd states:

During March 23rd, our troops waged battles in the former directions.

In the Barents Sea our warships sank an enemy transport of 7,000 tons.

On March 22nd, operating on various sectors of the front our aviation units destroyed 5 German tanks, about 100 trucks with troops and supplies, blew up 10 ammunition dumps and silenced 10 batteries of enemy field and anti-aircraft artillery.

On the Western front our troops continued their offensive and occupied a number of populated places. The troops of our N formation waged battles for the extension of their bases on the western bank of the Dniepr River. The Germans had concentrated on this sector many of their artillery and minethrower batteries and large infantry forces, and attempted to stop the advance of our units. The enemy launched a number of counter-attacks with tanks and infantry but affected by the Germans in this area north of DUBROVCHINA. The Soviets successfully repulsed all hostile counter-attacks and annihilated over 500 enemy officers and men.

North of Zhisdra, as a result of futile attempts to pierce our defence line the enemy suffered very serious losses in men and equipment.

To-day the Germans ceased their attacks against Soviet positions. Within the period of fighting on this sector, since March 19th, our troops disabled and burned up 140 German tanks, destroyed 52 guns, 102 machine-guns, and 32 minethrowers. The enemy lost in killed alone over 7,000 officers and men. Our troops captured large quantities of war materials and took prisoners.

In the area of Belgorod our troops waged defensive battles against the enemy infantry and tanks. The unit of our N formation, while repulsing the attacks of a German motorized division supported by tanks, annihilated about 400 hitlerites.

In the Kuban valley our troops, after a series of stubborn battles, captured the district centre of SLAVYANSKAYA. Our troops occupied also a number of other populated places. In the battle for the station of Slavyanskaya the enemy suffered heavy losses. Our troops captured quantities of war materials which are being itemised. —(TASS.)

borders of the command, withdrew to new defence lines, thus frustrating the German designs. In the course of these engagements our troops lost 38,512 men in killed and missing. During the same period our troops annihilated not less than 52,000 German officers and men. Such is the true result of the fighting between the Seversky Donets and the Dniepr River.

It is not clear that the hitlerite reports, concerning the losses of Soviet troops, its raids and has been fabricated to console and deceive the population of Germany, which until now cannot recover after the news of the defeat of the German fascist troops along the Soviet German front.—(TASS.)

Fascists Thrown Back Across Donets-River
MOSCOW, March 24. — East of Belgorod the hitlerites crossed the Northern Donets River and at a cost of heavy losses captured a populated place. By a counter-thrust of our troops the hitlerites were flung back across the river. The enemy abandoned on the field of action 300 dead officers and men, 7 disabled tanks, 12 trucks, and a large quantity of infantry arms.—(TASS.)

Morning Communique of the Soviet Information Bureau
MOSCOW, March 25. — During the night of March 23rd, our troops fought battles in the same directions as before.

On the Western front our troops continued their offensive operations. The Red Army troops of our N unit dislodged the enemy from several populated places. In the fighting for which they killed over 200 German officers and men.

In another sector our troops surrounded a detachment of German automatic riflemen in the forest and wiped it out.

North of Dukhovshchina, overcoming the enemy's stiff resistance, our troops captured several populated places. In a stiff engagement our N unit captured a tactically important line. The Germans launched two counter-attacks, but were beaten back. About 400 enemy dead remained on the battlefield. Our troops destroyed 2 enemy guns, one tank, 10 machineguns, 24 trucks, and smashed over 60 enemy block-houses and blindages, also captured quantities of war materials.

In the Belgorod step our anti-tank riflemen burnt up 4 enemy tanks and 5 trucks. In another sector the Soviet tankmen routed a German truck column. Six petrol tank-cars, and 11 trucks with ammunition were destroyed, and about 100 hitlerites were killed.

Yesterday, on the Leningrad front 13 German planes were shot down in air-combats, and by our anti-aircraft artillery fire.

Fighting a German punitive detachment, the guerrillas operating in the Vitebsk region, killed 50 hitlerites. The guerrillas of another Belorussian detachment derailed an enemy troop-train. Two locomotives, 6 cars and 6 platforms were smashed in the wreck. Over 40 German fascist invaders perished in the wreckage.—(TASS.)

在日兹德拉以北的战斗中击毙7,000名德军，摧毁140辆坦克

顿涅茨河前线击毙52,000名德军
莫斯科，3月25日电。——近来，希特勒分子在编造各种谎言连篇的“军事公报”方面表现出特别的狂热。他们笔锋一挥，便在纸面上消灭了数十个苏联步兵、摩托化和坦克部队。

例如，3月20日，德国新闻局发布了一份报告，声称自2月13日以来，在北顿涅茨河与第聂伯河之间的地区，据称已摧毁了9个苏联步兵师、6个步兵旅、4个骑兵师、9个机械化旅、29个坦克旅、2个坦克团和1个反坦克炮旅。

然而，这似乎还不足以让德国人满意，德国报告接着指出，此外，19个步兵师、18个摩托化和坦克旅以及红军其他部队和单位也遭受了重大损失。

为了使这份彻头彻尾的虚假报告显得逼真，德国的伪造者信手拈来地列举了一些数字，作为据称被摧毁的苏联师和旅的番号。

 suffice it to say（ suffice it to say 意为“只需说”），在德国新闻局报道的北顿涅茨河与第聂伯河之间的地区，从未存在过如此番号的苏联部队。希特勒分子声称已被摧毁的某些师和旅，在红军中根本从未存在过，而其中许多部队并未参加南部的战斗，因此不可能被摧毁，也不可能失去其基地。

2月底，德军指挥部在北顿涅茨河与第聂伯河之间的地区发动反攻，企图包围苏军并为他们制造一个“德国的斯大林格勒”。为此，德国人紧急从西欧向战区转移了大量新鲜的步兵和坦克师，并从德国调遣了110至115个补充营，以 replenish（补充）其破碎的部队。

总的来说，德国人现在梦想着对斯大林格勒进行报复，但一事无成，他们的计划彻底破产。我军在进行激烈的阻滞战斗并给予敌人重大杀伤后，在

莫斯科，3月24日电。——苏联新闻局3月23日晚间公报称：

3月23日当天，我军在各原有方向进行战斗。

在巴伦支海，我方军舰击沉了一艘7,000吨的敌方运输船。

3月22日，我方航空部队在前线各段作战，摧毁了5辆德军坦克、约100辆载有部队和物资的卡车，炸毁了10个弹药库，并使10个敌方野战炮和高射炮阵地哑火。

在西线，我军继续进攻并占领了许多居民点。我军N部队的官兵为扩大在第聂伯河西岸的基地而战。德军在该地段集中了许多炮兵和掷弹筒阵地以及大量步兵部队，并试图阻止我军的推进。敌人在杜布罗夫奇纳（DUBROVCHINA）以北地区发动了多次坦克和步兵反攻。苏军成功击退了所有敌方的反攻，歼灭了500多名敌军官兵。

在日兹德拉以北，由于试图突破我方防线的尝试徒劳无功，敌人在人员和装备方面遭受了非常严重的损失。

今天，德军停止了对苏军阵地的攻击。自3月19日以来，在该地段的战斗期间，我军使140辆德军坦克瘫痪并烧毁，摧毁了52门火炮、102挺机枪和32具掷弹筒。仅阵亡一项，敌人就损失了7,000多名官兵。我军缴获了大量战争物资并俘虏了战俘。

在别尔哥罗德地区，我军与敌方步兵和坦克进行了防御战。我军N部队的一个单位在击退一支有坦克支援的德军摩托化师的进攻时，歼灭了约400名希特勒分子。

在库班河谷，经过一系列顽强的战斗，我军占领了区中心斯拉维扬斯卡亚（SLAVYANSKAYA）。我军还占领了其他一些居民点。在争夺斯拉维扬斯卡亚车站的战斗中，敌人遭受了重大损失。我军缴获了大量战争物资，目前正在清点中。——（塔斯社。）

指挥部的边界范围内，撤退到新的防线，从而挫败了德国的图谋。在这些战斗中，我军阵亡和失踪人数为38,512人。在同一时期，我军歼灭了不少于52,000名德国官兵。这就是北顿涅茨河与第聂伯河之间战斗的真实结果。

显然，关于苏军损失及其突袭行动的希特勒分子报告，是为了安慰和欺骗德国民众而编造的，德国民众至今仍未从苏德前线德国法西斯军队战败的消息中恢复过来。——（塔斯社。）

法西斯分子被赶回顿涅茨河对岸
莫斯科，3月24日电。——在别尔哥罗德以东，希特勒分子渡过了北顿涅茨河，并以惨重代价占领了一个居民点。在我军的反击下，希特勒分子被赶回河对岸。敌人在战场上遗弃了300具官兵尸体、7辆瘫痪的坦克、12辆卡车和大量步兵武器。——（塔斯社。）

苏联新闻局晨间公报
莫斯科，3月25日电。——3月23日夜间，我军在与此前相同的方向进行战斗。

在西线，我军继续进攻行动。我军N单位的红军部队将敌人从几个居民点驱逐出去。在这些战斗中，他们击毙了200多名德国官兵。

在另一地段，我军在森林中包围了一支德军自动步枪手分队并将其全歼。

在杜霍夫什奇纳（Dukhovshchina）以北，我军克服了敌人的顽强抵抗，占领了几个居民点。在一次激烈的战斗中，我军N单位占领了一条具有战术重要性的防线。德军发动了两次反攻，但被击退。战场上留下了约400具敌军尸体。我军摧毁了2门敌方火炮、1辆坦克、10挺机枪、24辆卡车，并捣毁了60多个敌方碉堡和掩体，还缴获了大量战争物资。

在别尔哥罗德草原，我方反坦克步枪手烧毁了4辆敌方坦克和5辆卡车。在另一地段，苏联坦克兵击溃了一支德军卡车车队。6辆油罐车和11辆载有弹药的卡车被摧毁，约100名希特勒分子被击毙。

昨天，在列宁格勒前线，通过空战和我方高射炮火力，共击落13架德国飞机。

游击队在维捷布斯克地区与一支德军惩罚性分队作战，击毙了50名希特勒分子。另一支白俄罗斯分队的游击队使一列敌军运兵车脱轨。事故中毁坏了2台机车、6节车厢和6节平板车。40多名德国法西斯入侵者在事故中丧生。——（塔斯社。）
